uz:
Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon. Kecha va kunduz (roman) 
 
 
2
Muhabbatning saroyi keng ekan, yo‘lni yo‘qotdim-ku,  
Asrlik tosh yanglig‘ bu xatarlik yo‘lda qotdim-ku. 
 
Karashma dengizin ko‘rdim, na nozlik to‘lqini bordir,  
Halokat bo‘lgusin bilmay qulochni katta otdim-ku. 
 
Ajab dunyo ekan bu ishq dunyosi, ayo do‘stlar,  
Bu dunyo deb u dunyoni bahosiz pulga sotdim-ku. 
 
Uning gulzorida bulbul o‘qib qon ayladi bag‘rim.  
Ko‘zimdan yoshni jo‘ aylab alamlar ichra botdim-ku. 
 
Qalandardek yurib dunyoni kezdim, topmayin yorni  
Yana kulbamga qayg‘ular, alamlar birla qaytdim-ku. 
 
Muhabbat osmonida go‘zal Cho‘lpon edim, do‘stlar,  
Quyoshning nuriga toqat qilolmay yerga botdim-ku. KECHA Birinchi kitob Hamal keldi, amal keldi.
en: Night and Day: Night First Book When spring comes, the work begins.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xalq maqoli. I Har yil bir keladigan bahor sevinchi yana ko‘ngillarni qitiklay boshladi.
en: —Folk saying 1 E very year the coming of spring joy tickles hearts.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yana tabiatning dildiragan tanlariga iliq qon yugurdi...
en: Warm blood rushes to nature’s trembling bodies once again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tollarning ko‘m-ko‘k sochpopuklari qizlarning mayda o‘rilgan kokillariday selkillab tushmoqqa boshladi.
en: The ever-so-green sochpopuks of the willows begin to quiver like a young woman’s intricate braids.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Muz tagida loyqalanib oqqan suvlarning g‘amli yuzlari kuldi, o‘zlari horg‘in-horg‘in oqsalarda, bo‘shalgan qul singari erkinlik nash’asini kemira-kemira ilgari bosadilar.
en: Under the ice the somber cheeks of the murky running waters begin to smile; the water, though tired and limping, like a freed slave, begins to gnaw its way forward towards the satisfaction of liberty.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Simyog‘ochlarning uchlarida yakka-yakka qushlar ko‘rina boshladi.
en: Birds begin to appear one by one at the ends of branches.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Birinchi ko‘ringan ko‘klam qushi birinchi yorilgan bodroq nash’asini beradi.
en: The first bird of spring brings the pleasure of the season’s first well-fried corn.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bultur ekilib, ko‘p qoshlarni qoraytirgan o‘sma ildizidan yana bosh ko‘tarib chiqdi...
en: Planted last year, the cobs have just recently poked their heads out from that kohl root that will be applied above the eyes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Muloyim qo‘llarda ivib, suvga aylangandan keyin go‘zal ko‘zlarning supasida yonboshlashni muncha yaxshi ko‘rar ekan bu ko‘kat!
en: Oh, how that green of spring, which not long ago emerged from wintry ice that melts in warm hands, so loves to lie on the courtyard platform of the eyes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Erkaklarning gullik do‘ppisiga tegmay, yalang ayollar bilan, ularning sochlari, gajaklari va ro‘mol popuklari bilan hazillashib o‘ynagan salqin shabada... ko‘klam nash’asi bilan sho‘xlik qiladi.
en: Oh, how the cool wind that playfully toys with those bare women—with their hair and their curls, with the ends of their headscarves—never touches the flower -embroidered skullcaps of men. Spring frolics in the revelation of its beauty.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hayot nega bu qadar go‘zal va shirin bo‘ladi bahorda?
en: Why is life so beautiful and sweet in spring? ...
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Zebi (Zebinisa)ning qish ichi siqilib, zanglab chiqqan, ko‘ngli bahorning iliq hovuri bilan ochila tushgan; endi, ustiga poxol to‘shalgan aravada bo‘lsa ham, allaqaylarga, dala-qirlarga chiqib yayrashni tusay boshlagan edi.
en: Zebi’s soul had felt compressed all winter, as if rusting, but it began to expand with spring’s warmth. She had just begun thirsting to ride out into the fields and meadows in a horse-drawn cart, even one covered in straw.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qish ichi ham keti uzilmagan sovchilar bir-ikki haftadan beri kelishdan to‘xtaganlar, endi tashqari eshikning «g‘iyt» etishi — birikki  ayolning astagina bosib, paranjisini sudrab kirib kelishiga dalolat qilmas, hali endigina o‘n beshga qadam qo‘ygan bu yosh qizning go‘dak ko‘nglini uncha cho‘chitmas edi.
en: The chain of matchmakers that poured into her house uninterruptedly all winter had stopped momentarily for the last one to two weeks, and now the creak of a door, the slow steps of a woman, and the rustle of a paranji no longer terrified her young heart. Ever since she had seen a few farms and some wide courtyards, though her family lived in the city, her heart had started to long for the fields and meadows, for faraway places.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘k terish bahonasi bilan bir-ikki marta keng hovlilarga, shahar ichida bo‘lsa hamki, dala-tuzlarga chiqib kelganidan beri ko‘ngli qirlarni, dalalarni, ishqilib olis-olis joylarni yana ko‘proq tusay boshlagan edi.
en: Her father hadn’t yet returned from the morning prayer, her mother was busy milking the cow, and she was sweeping their small courtyard. The sudden opening of the outside door set her heart aflutter.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Otasi bomdoddan kirmagan, onasi sigir sog‘ish bilan ovora, o‘zi kichkina sahnni supurib turgan vaqtida tashqari eshikning besaranjom ochilishi Zebining ko‘nglini bir qur seskantirib oldi.
en: In one hand she held her broom, the other hand was on her knee, she stared intently at the open door. It couldn’t have been her father since not much time had passed since he had left for the prayer, having closed the big door on a heavy chain while coughing and clearing his throat as usual.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir qo‘lida supurgisi, bir qo‘li tizzasida — yerga egilgan ko‘yi eshik tomonga tikilib qoldi. Otasining odatdagi tomoq qirish va yo‘talishlar bilan, katta eshikning og‘ir zanjirini sharaq-shuruq qilib tushirib, namozga chiqib ketganiga hali ko‘p o‘tmagan edi.
en: This man, who couldn’t tell haram from halal, had the habit of sitting for a long time at prayer, staying to put out the candles in the mosque long after others had left.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Halol-haromni ko‘p ham farq qilmayturgan bu odamning avrodda o‘tirish odatlari, hatto hammadan keyin qolib, machit shamlarini puflab chiqish rasmlari bo‘lardi.
en: Through the door hurried in a young girl Zebi’s age. This girl, still not yet a woman, wore a paranji that older women had wrapped over her to protect her from wandering eyes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aytgandek, eshikdan shoshilib kirib kelgan — yoshgina, o‘zi tengi bir qizcha bo‘ldi.
en: The long hems of the paranji enclosed her girlish arms like a well-kept secret.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hali tuzuk-quruq odam qatoriga kirib yetmagan bu qizchani katta xotinlarning oriyat paranjisiga burkaganlar, paranjining uzun etaklari katta bir tugundek uning qo‘ltig‘ini to‘lg‘azardi...
en: The tightly covered girl, entering the female side of the house almost jumping, threw off her paranji, and, full of youthful energy, ran up to Zebi and embraced her. The two of them looked at each other rejoicing.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘rangan qiz ichkari eshikdan hatlar-hatlamas paranjini irg‘itdi va o‘zining bolalik ruhi bilan yugurganicha borib Zebini quchoqladi. Ikkalasi quvona-quvona ko‘rishdilar.
en: Zebi laid her tinues the metaphor equating natural and cultural life by suggesting that the supa is the plane created by the kohl line which women drew to connect their eyebrows, a traditional sign of beauty.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Supurgi yetgan joyidan nariga o‘tmasdan yerga yonboshladi...
en: broom on the ground without returning it to its place.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikkala yosh — yuzlari kulgan, ko‘ngillari yozilgan — qo‘ltiqlashib ayvonga bordilar va Zebining otasi turib ketgan so‘rining chekkasiga o‘tirishdilar.
en: Their cheeks bright, hearts bursting, they took one another by the hand and headed towards the porch to sit together in Zebi’s father’s place. Saltanat still hadn’t explained why she had arrived at Zebi’s home panting and exhausted so early.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Salti (Saltanat) erta saharda munaqa halloslab kelishining sababini hali aytgani yo‘q edi, ular ko‘rishgan hamon, yosh qizlarning o‘z oralarida o‘taturgan mahram gaplarini gaplashib, tikayotgan kashtalari, piltaga kirgan do‘ppilari to‘g‘risida bir-birlariga kalta-kalta ma’lumot berishgan edilar.
en: They were engrossed in each other, in sharing mahram secrets, in advising one another how best to sew designs and stuff skull caps with paper. Saltanat suddenly opened up regarding her arrival: “I didn’t rush here so early without a reason.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Salti endi gap ochdi:
en: …” “I sensed it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Erta saharlab chopganim bekorga emas... — Men ham sezganman...
en: … My heart fluttered.” “Why, friend?” “Those terrible matchmakers, you know.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yuragim bir qur seskanib ham oldi... — Nimaga, o‘rtoqjon?
en: … They came without end all winter.” “I am sick of them too, they’re exhausting.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘zingiz bilgan sovchilar balosi-da... Qish ichi keti uzilmadi.
en: That’s why I came to invite you to the village.” “Oh, what a wonderful idea!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Menam bezganman, jonim qaqa... shuning uchun bir qishloqqa chiqib kelsammikan, deb edim... — Nimasini aytasiz...
en: The water in the canals has already peeped out from under the ice.” Zebi’s face was filled with all the signs of her winter fatigue.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ariqdagi suv ham muzning tagidan chiqdi-ku. Zebining yuzini, shu topda, butun qish ichi to‘planib qolgan
en: Her tired eyes, which stared so intently at the stitches in the blankets underneath her, were cloudy like glass under warm breath.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: horg‘inlikning asarlari egallagan edi. Uning ikkala yuzi, ayniqsa, ko‘rpaning katta-katta qavig‘iga tikilgan andishalik ko‘zlari hovur bosgan oynakning betiga o‘xshardi.
en: Saltanat’s face, on the other hand, like a shining star, was full of contentment and happiness, far from any worry, and reflected the waves of joy escaping from the deepest corners of her heart.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aksincha, Saltining yuzlari charaqlagan yulduzday, sernash’a, quvnoq va har qanday andishadan yiroq bo‘lib, ko‘nglining chuqur burchaklaridan chiqib kelgan sevinch to‘lqinlarini aks ettirardi.
en: She couldn’t sense the heavy despair in Zebi’s words. Although her eyes were on Zebi, her thoughts were in another place altogether.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun u Zebining so‘ng so‘zlaridagi og‘ir ma’yuslikni payqay olmadi.
en: “Do you know Enaxon? My friend in Yoyilmasoy?” Zebi lifted her head and looked at her friend.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning ko‘zlari Zebida bo‘lsa ham, nazarlari boshqa yoqlarda edi.
en: That look showed that she couldn’t remember Enaxon.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Enaxonni bilasiz-a? Yoyilma soydagi o‘rtog‘im bor-ku?
en: Saltanat added, “Last fall, do you remember, she came to us with her sister-in-law?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi boshini ko‘tarib, o‘rtog‘iga qaradi, shu qarash uning nechikdir Enaxonni eslolmay turganini ko‘rsatardi.
en: At that time, I invited several guests, but you didn’t come, your father didn’t reply to my invitation. …” Zebi shook her head.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra Salti ta’rif qildi:
en: “Yes, yes … I know, I know.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘tgan kuz biznikiga mehmon bo‘lib kelishdiku — kelinbibisi bilan birga?
en: I didn’t see her myself, but I heard.” “When she came that fall, her sister-in-law invited me to visit her in return.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘shanda necha marta kishi yuborib chaqirtirdim, bormadingiz, otangiz javob ber-madi...
en: I’ve been planning to go as soon as spring came.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi bosh tebratdi:
en: She just recently reminded me.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, ha... bildim, bildim.
en: I’m going there with some other girls soon.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zini ko‘rganim yo‘q-ku, eshitib bilaman.
en: I’ll take you with me.” “When?” Saltanat understood a good deal from Zebi’s short question. That question alone showed that, if she could, Zebi would that very day take her paranji (without putting it on!) and rush as far away from her home as possible.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ana o‘sha qiz o‘sha safar kelganida meni aytib ketib edi.
en: Realizing this, Saltanat said, “I want to take you with me, dear friend!”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bahorlashib bir borib kelaman, deb yurib edim.
en: And the two young girls once again embraced each other in their boundless happiness.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yaqinda yana aytib yuboribdi.
en: ... A mother’s heart is usually tender.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunga teng-to‘shlarim bilan bir borib kelmoqchiman.
en: Zebi’s mother, as soon as she heard Saltanat ’s invitation, gave her consent.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sizni ham olib boraman... — Qachon?
en: “Very well, go be free and frolic.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining bu kalta savolidan Salti ko‘p narsani angladi.
en: Winter has made your hearts tense. … Young things.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu savol Zebining iloji bo‘lsa shu kun paranjisini qo‘liga olib (yopinib ham o‘tirmasdan!), shu yerdan uzoqlashmoq uchun talpinganini ko‘rsatardi.
en: But …” Zebi knew her mother’s answer well ahead of time. Qurvonbibi was a mother who wanted nothing but her daughter’s happiness.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun Salti: — Men sizni olib ketgali keldim, aylanay!
en: She wished and truly desired everything good and beneficial in the world for her only daughter.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi. Va ikki yosh bola nihoyasiz quvonchlar ichida yana bir-birlariga chirmashdilar...
en: “But …” The poor girls didn’t have a chance to bring to crest again their waves of joy when Zebi’s mother added that “but” to her words of agreement.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Odatda onaning ko‘ngli yumshoq bo‘ladi.
en: They all fell silent.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining onasi — Qurbonbibi Saltidan haligi chaqiriqni eshitgandan keyin darhol rozilik berdi: — Mayli, o‘ynab, yozilib kelinglar.
en: Each of them saw a singular impediment before their eyes: Zebi—her father, Qurvonbibi—her husband, and Saltanat from beneath her eyelids saw the old man as cold as snow.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qish ichi yuraklaring g‘ash bo‘lgandir...
en: Only a mother can clear such cloudy weather.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yosh narsalar, — dedi. Zebi onasining beradigan javobini ilgaridan bilardi.
en: “When your father comes from his morning prayers,” she said looking at Saltanat, “let me try to reason with him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu ona qizining saodatidan boshqa narsani bilmaydirgan onalardan edi.
en: He won’t refuse me.” Then she looked at Zebi: “You, dear, prepare the house, see your friend in, and set the table.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Dunyoda qanday yaxshilik va xayriyatlik bo‘lsa, hammasini shu birgina qizi uchun istar va orzu qilardi. Lekin...
en: I’ll speak with your father over tea and tell him what you told me.” The girls remained silent because both knew Razzoq-sufi’s character well.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Onaning rozilik so‘zlariga bu birgina «lekin» elchib kelganidan, bechora qizlar sevinish to‘lqinlarini yana bir qur ko‘tarishga fursat topolmadilar.
en: To get him to accept even the most agreeable of things one had either to be his master or be wealthy. The man had never listened to a single word of advice from his equals.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hamma jim qoldi. Har kim o‘z oldida bir narsa topib shunga ko‘z tikkan va u narsada Zebi — o‘z otasini, Qurvonbibi — o‘z erini, Salti — qovog‘idan doim qor yog‘ib turgan sovuq bir so‘fini ko‘rardi.
en: For Razzoq to accept advice from women, or, to be precise, one little suggestion from his wife, he would have had to be remade from head to toe.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu bulutli havoni ochmoq faqat onaning vazifasi edi:
en: For that reason, Zebi’s eyes grew wide with worry as she stood silently in the house. She began to cry.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Otasi bomdoddan kirsin, — dedi u Saltiga qarab, — men o‘zim yotig‘i bilan aytib ko‘ray, yo‘q demas, — so‘ngra Zebiga yuzlandi: — Sen, qizim, uyga joy qil, o‘rtog‘ingni o‘tqiz, dasturxon sol.
en: After she prepared the table for breakfast, she stuffed tea leaves into the pot by the hearth. “No word of father?” she asked her mother.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Biz, otang bilan, choyni so‘rida ichib, haligi gapni gaplashamiz. Ikkala qiz ham og‘iz ochmay jim qolishdi.
en: Qurvonbibi, after looking first at the door to the street, at the sun rising up between the trees next to the door, and then at her daughter by the hearth, answered.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Chunki Razzoq so‘fining mijozini ularning ikkalasi ham yaxshi bilardi.
en: “I don’t know. Could prayers have gone late?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘figa eng ma’qul bir masalani bo‘lsa ham uqtirib roziligini olmoq uchun yo o‘zining piri, yoki katta bir davlatga ega bo‘lish kerak edi.
en: Put the tea down quickly, finish sweeping the spots you missed, and come here.” Though she had no desire to take up the broom again, she dreaded that her friend might think that she wasn’t an obedient daughter.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U odam o‘z tenglaridan hech birining hech qachon hech bir gapini tinglagan emasdi.
en: She silently took the broom in one hand, put her other hand on her knee, and started to sweep the ground.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ayollardan maslahat, ayniqsa, o‘z xotinidan bir taklif eshitmoq uchun Razzoq so‘fining qayta boshdan bunyodga kelishi kerak bo‘lardi...
en: Having waited for Zebi to start the tea, Saltanat got up from her place behind the table in the house and went out to check on her friend.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuning uchun Zebi ko‘zlari andisha bilan kengayib ochilgani holda indamasdan joylarni yig‘a boshladi.
en: Zebi ran up to meet her and apologized. “Friend,” she said, “Father is still at prayers.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U o‘rinlarni yig‘ishtirib, nonushta joylarini tayyorlab bo‘lgandan so‘ng o‘choq boshida choynaklarga choy tashlarkan:
en: That’s his way. He should come any minute.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Otamdan darak yo‘q-ku?
en: Don’t be upset.” The sincerity with which Zebi uttered her request could only be expressed between young girls in a close friendship. One had to see Zebi’s face as she said that “don’t be upset” with the broom in one hand and the other hand on her knee, never lifting the broom from the ground and only holding her head up to know that her whole being was submitted to Saltanat’s will.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb so‘radi onasidan.
en: Her soul, her aspirations , her love, her joy.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qurvonbibi bir ko‘cha eshigiga, bir yonboshdagi daraxtlar orasidan ko‘tarilib kelayotgan quyoshga, bir o‘choqboshidagi qiziga qaragandan keyin:
en: All of these flew towards Saltanat; they were shot at her, they wrapped her up, moved her, embraced her! Zebi’s face, clear as the moon and bright as the sun, openly revealed the truth of her being.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bilmadim, avrod cho‘zilibroq ketdimikin?
en: Saltanat didn’t see her friend’s sincerity with her eyes, but understood it through her heart.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sen choyni jindek qo‘yib turib, chala qoldirgan yerlaringni supiratur, kelib qolar, — dedi.
en: She understood so well that she didn’t bother to answer Zebi, but suddenly grabbed the broom in her friend’s hands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi shu topda yana qaytib qo‘liga supurgi olishni istamasada, o‘rtog‘ining «bu qiz enasining gapiga kirmas ekan», degan o‘yga borishini o‘ylab, indamasdan supurgini qo‘liga oldi va bir qo‘lini bir tizzasiga qo‘yib, sahn betini supura boshladi.
en: She knew that if she could take the broom and sweep some for her friend, then that would be a sufficient response to Zebi’s sincerity. Zebi released the broom, but quickly said, “Voy, what are you doing!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining choy damlab kelishini kutib,
en: Put it down, I’ll do it myself!” and seized the broom.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: uyda — dasturxon boshida o‘tirgan Salti ikkala qanoti ochiq turgan eshik orqali bu holni ko‘rganidan keyin o‘rnidan turib, o‘rtog‘ining yoniga chiqdi. Zebi uni uzr aytib qarshi oldi:
en: Saltanat didn’t give it back; Saltanat ran, she chased; lost in themselves, instead of sweeping the courtyard the two friends turned Zebi’s home on its head, their noise and shouting disturbing their whole world as they chased one another.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘rtoqjon, — dedi, — otam avrodda o‘tirib qoldi, shekilli, shunaqa odati bor. Endiyoq kirib kelsa kerak.
en: Razzoq-sufi, who preferred the quiet of a graveyard, the silence of a mosque, whose very soul was coarse and frowning, returned to this chaos!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xafa bo‘lmang-a? Bu so‘nggi kalta jumlaning aytilishidagi samimiyat bir-biri bilan yaqin o‘rtoq tutishgan yosh qizlardagina bo‘ladi.
en: A voice emerged from the doorway: “What is this hell?!” he bellowed like lightning striking a tree, petrifying the two young girls in their places.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Xafa bo‘lmang-a?» deb turgan vaqtida Zebining yuzini ko‘rish kerak edi, bir qo‘lida supurgi, bir qo‘li tizzasida, supurgi ham yerdan uzib olingan emas, faqat bosh yuqori ko‘tarilganu butun vujud Saltining ixtiyorida!
en: Qurvonbibi , ever faithful to her husband, had already shouted, “enough already!” a few times herself. If the cold old man hadn’t returned, the two young girls’ pent up tension from the long winter would have expanded with the warmth of spring and produced even more mischief.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘ngil, orzu, sevgi, sevinch... bular hammasi Saltiga tomon uchadi, unga tomon otiladi, uni o‘rab, uni aylantirib, uni quchadi!
en: In fact, the girls had completely forgotten themselves. How could their games with one another not release the coiled spring of their agitation, not break the dam holding back the flood?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining yuzlaridagi — oyday tiniq va quyoshday yorug‘ bu holat moddiy haqiqatlar qadar ochiq ko‘rinardi.
en: To stop such madness from overflowing, of course, equally mad screams and thunderously powerful force were needed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘rtog‘ining bu samimiyatini Salti ham ko‘z bilan ko‘ribgina emas, ko‘ngil bilan sezib anglagan edi.
en: ... Razzoq-sufi had such power in excess.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuning uchun u Zebining so‘ziga javob ham berib o‘tirmasdan , birdaniga uning qo‘lidagi supurgiga yopishdi.
en: This man, as a jadid denizen of the city said of him, “was one of those ancient monsters put out for display.” The old woman that shot him from her womb perfectly healthy and swaddled him for the first time was named Hamroh.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘z ko‘nglida, supurgini olib, bir oz supurishib bersa, haligi samimiyatga yarasha javob bergan bo‘lardi.
en: She had a reputation for jokes and mischief. After swaddling him, she looked at the face of her child, which hadn’t yet been disfigured by manhood, and coddled him with these words: “My dear guest, who has upset you?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi supurgini qo‘ldan oldirdi, lekin o‘rtog‘i supura boshlagandan so‘ng:
en: Who has hurt you? Tell me!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Voy, bu nimasi!
en: Unfurrow your brow!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qo‘ying, o‘zim supuraman!
en: You have come into the bright world! Give thanks!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb yana supurgiga yopishdi.
en: Be happy! Laugh a little!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Salti bermadi, bu olmoq istadi; Salti qochdi, bu quvladi; shunday qilib, sahnni supurish o‘rniga bu ikki o‘rtoq butun hovlini boshlariga ko‘tarib, shovqinlar va qiyqirishlar bilan dunyoni buzib, bir-birlarini quvlashib ketdilar...
en: Smile! Grin!” Razzoq-sufi, who hadn’t laughed then, still has not laughed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘z uyining qabristonlar qadar jimjit, xonaqohlar qadar unsiz, o‘z ko‘ngli qadar tund va xo‘mraygan bo‘lishini istagan Razzoq so‘fi xuddi shu ola-to‘polon ustiga kirib keldi!
en: There is a big difference between laughing and crying. There is again a great distance between laughing and maintaining quiet gravity.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Eshikdan kirar-kirmas ovozining boricha:
en: It cannot be said that Razzoq-sufi ever laughed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bu nima qiyomat!!! — deb shovqin solishi ikkala yosh qizni, chaqmoq tekkan daraxtday, turgan joylarida qotirib qo‘ydi.
en: He “laughed” in situations where laughter couldn’t be avoided, but his laugh was pained like that of a sick person; it was unpleasant like a cold joke, injurious like false well wishes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘qsa, so‘fi erining dindor xotini bo‘lgan Qurvonbibi ham «bas endi!» deb ozmuncha qichqirmagan edi...
en: One day Zebi said with a serious face: “Father has never laughed.” As soon as she heard her daughter’s words, Qurvonbibi scolded her.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Agar bu sovuq so‘fi kirib kelgan bo‘lmasa, ikki yosh qizning qish bo‘yi to‘plangan ko‘ngil g‘ashliklari bir oz sho‘xlik bilan ancha yozilgan bo‘lardi.
en: She openly scolded her daughter for speaking the truth, but how many times had Qurvonbibi repeated the same truth to herself in secret?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zotan, ularning o‘zlarini unutar darajada bir- birlari bilan bu xilda o‘ynashuvlari o‘sha g‘am-g‘ashlar pur-jinasining bo‘shalishi, siqintilar oqimining to‘g‘onini buzib, oldinga tomon yo‘l solish emasmidi?
en: It is easy to speak of someone else’s faults with a sharp tongue, but those who can speak of their own faults with their own tongue are rare, and though Qurvonbibi had a very sharp tongue, she couldn’t count herself among that rare class.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bunday telbalarcha ko‘pirib-toshuvlarni to‘xtatmoq uchun ham, albatta, telbalarcha hayqirishlar, chaqmoq qadar quvvatli zarblar lozim bo‘lardi.
en: As sharp as her tongue was, Razzoq-sufi was to the same extent a reticent, tight-lipped, boring man who kept to himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Razzoq so‘fida unday quvvat ortig‘i bilan bor. Bu odam, jadidnamo bir hamshahrining deganidek, «ko‘rgazmaga qo‘yilaturgan antiqa maxluqlardan edi».
en: In the outside world, that is the world outside his home, his sole, ever-present task was to answer “yes, yes” to those who were more powerful than he and to shake his head “no, no” to those less powerful.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Aytishlaricha, uni ona qornidan sihat-salomat tushirtirgan va birinchi daf’a yo‘rgaklagan kampir hazilkashligi va sho‘xligi bilan xotin-xalaj o‘rtasida dong chiqargan Hamro enaymish.
en: While he was at home, not one word that could be called meaningful , healthy speech which an adult uses around children ever left his lips.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bolani yo‘rgaklaganidan keyin hali u qadar odam kepatasiga kirmagan yuzlariga tikilgan va mana bu so‘zlar bilan erkalatganmish:
en: He didn’t think it necessary to move his tongue in the presence of womenfolk, and his muteness before his family members was a point of pride.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Aylanay, mehmon, kimdan xafa bo‘lib tushdingiz?
en: “This tongue,” he told himself, “moves only in remembrance of God.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kim ozor berdi sizga?
en: This mouth opens only for God.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ayting! Qovog‘ingizni ochsangiz-chi!
en: The mouth and tongue are the dearest and most blessed parts of a believer ’s body.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yorug‘ dunyoga keldingiz! Shukur qiling!
en: Should they really be embarrassed by being used in front of such a low creature as a woman?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Se-vining! Mundoq bir kuling!
en: If they were meant to be used with women, then God on high would have granted dogs speech!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kulimsirang! Iljaying!..
en: No, only the most necessary phrases should be used with women.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘shanda kulmagan Razzoq so‘fi undan keyin ham kulmay o‘tdi. Kulish bilan yig‘lash orasida katta farq bor.
en: Those creatures should only be spoken with concerning the most urgent matters and that’s all!”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kulish bilan kulmasdan tekkina jiddiyat saqlab turish orasida ham anchagina masofa bor.
en: Every Uzbek man calls his wife—his lawful partner in life—by his daughter or his son’s name. It just won’t do to call his wife by name.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun Razzoq so‘fining kulishlarini kulish, deb bo‘lmaydi.
en: If his wife’s name was Maryam and his daughter’s Xadicha, a faithful Muslim wouldn’t bring shame on himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kulmasdan chidab bo‘lmaydigan maqomlarda u ham kuladi, lekin u kulish — kasal odamning kulishiday og‘ir, bir xil sovuq hazillarday malol keltiruvchi, yolg‘on xushomadlarday ko‘ngilga uruvchi bo‘lardi.
en: He would call his wife Xadicha. Most mother-daughter pairs would both answer, “yes, sir!” and the true head of the family would specify: “I mean the elder, the elder!” But he would never say Maryam.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir kun Zebining juda jiddiy bir chehra bilan:
en: Our Razzoq-sufi, our faithful Muslim didn’t observe this tradition.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Otam kulmas ekan-da!
en: He always called his lawful partner in life Fitna.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deganini eshitib, Qurvonbibi koyib bergan edi.
en: “Fitna, bring me my turban!” he would declare.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu haqiqatni aytgani uchun qizidan alayna-oshkor koyingan Qurvonbibi, bu haqiqatni o‘zi o‘z ko‘nglida necha marta takrorlagan bo‘lsaykin?.. Til bilan birovning aybini aytish oson, o‘z tili bilan o‘z aybini aytadiganlar juda kam, Qurvonbibi har qancha so‘zga epchil xotin bo‘lsa ham, uni bu kamlar orasiga qo‘shib bo‘lmaydi.
en: “Fitna, where is your damn daughter?” “Fitna, give me some money!” Whether she caused havoc in her husband’s life on purpose or it was just her nature, Fitna wasn’t an inaccurate label for Qurvonbibi, who was no stranger to guile and perfidy.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qurvonbibi so‘zga qancha epchil bo‘lsa, Razzoq so‘fi shu qadar kamgap, indamas, damini ichiga solgan, zikna odam edi. Tashqari olamda, ya’ni o‘z hovlisidan tashqarida uning doimiy va birdan-bir vazifasi:
en: Even if she wasn’t all that upset by the fact that her husband didn’t speak a word in front of womenfolk, she suffered from his not speaking to her, and she knew how to use all manners of tricks to coax words from him and even excite his tongue into singing.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: o‘zidan ulug‘ va kuchlilar gapirsa — «hovva-hovva», demak, o‘zidan past va kuchsizlar gapirsa — «yo‘q, yo‘q», degan ma’nida bosh chayqash bo‘lardi.
en: With one word, she would not just upset her husband: she would enrage him. Just look at how Razzoq-sufi wags his tongue in front of the womenfolk!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uyida vaqtida uning og‘zidan odam bolalari o‘rtasida yuraturgan tuzuk, ma’nilik va «gap» desa bo‘ladigan bir so‘z chiqmas edi.
en: Oh my! “They say your elder master is quite upset with you,” Qurvonbibi said to Razzoq-sufi one day.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Umuman, so‘fining bu bobda o‘ziga ko‘ra asoli bir maslagi bor: u o‘zi maqtanib aytganiday, xotin-xalaj oldida og‘iz ochib til qaldiratishni ravo ko‘rmaydi. «Bu til, — deydi so‘fi, — doim xudoning zikri bilan qaldiraydi.
en: Razzoq-sufi’s face, normally hard and motionless like a stone, suddenly came to life with various movements and changes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu og‘iz hamma vaqt xudoning zikriga ochiladi.
en: “What did you say, Fitna?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Og‘iz bilan til — bandaning jismida eng aziz va tabarruk a’zolar.
en: Why was he upset?” “You flirted with a boy who came to have his braid cut. …” That was it!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ishqilib mehmonlarni xursand qilsam, bo‘ldimi?

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi. Shundan so‘ng ikkalasi bel ushlashib, uyga tomon yura boshladilar.
en: Umrinisabibi stretched out her neck to her as far as she could to look at the open door.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yaxshi maslahat! Jon, kelinbibi, bir ish qiling!
en: Then she again bent down to the ear of the young wife.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi Enajon kelinbibisini mahkamroq quchoqlab.
en: “It’s been only five months since you’ve been married.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kelin birdaniga to‘xtab:
en: Do you really want a rival?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ularnikidan hech kimni chaqitirdikmi? — deb so‘radi.
en: You must have known what a hound your husband is!” “Voy, dammit all!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Enaxon ham yetgan joyidan to‘xtab: — Yo‘q!
en: Have I lost my mind?!” she screamed and buried her face in the pillow, beating her clenched left hand against her face.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deya javob berdi. — Kim biladi, deysiz, muni?
en: “My dear, you acted like a complete child.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Mingboshining falon-falonlari bizni ko‘ziga iladimi?» deb xabar ham qilmabmiz.
en: You didn’t think. Word of this singer girl’s voice has already made the rounds.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi qanday bo‘lar ekan?
en: She’s on everyone’s lips.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Biz shu kechaga mingboshi tog‘aning qizi bilan kichik xotinini chaqirtiraylik. Kecha chaqirtirganimizda kelmasalar, bugun chaqitirsak, albatta, kelishadi.
en: Could a rabid womanizer like your husband hear that nightingale-like voice and not immediately call for a matchmaker?” The young wife suddenly got up from the ground and threw herself on Umrinisabibi’s shoulders.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siz nima deb o‘tiribsiz!
en: “What have I done, auntie? I lost my senses, my senses!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebixonning ovozi, ashulalari undan kattaroklarni ham sudrab keltiradi.
en: What do we do now? Tell me, what can I do?” Umrinisabibi stroked her young friend’s head.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siz xotirjam bo‘ling.
en: “Don’t worry,” she said.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Men o‘zim g‘izillab chiqib kelaman.
en: “What’s done is done.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu kecha bitta-yarimta ashula eshitib, suhbatni ko‘rishsa, ertaga, albatta, chaqirtirishadi.
en: Somehow we’ll repair that branch!” “But how?” “Don’t rush, let’s think. We’ll figure it out.”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikkalasi, yuzlari yulduzday charaqlagani holda, darichadan ichkariga hatlagan vaqtlarida Zebining «Qora sochim» kuyiga aytayotgan ashulasi quloqlarni shirin-shirin qitiqlamoqda edi...
en: The two of them were silent, lost in thought. Umrinisabibi began to fiddle with the ends of her white gauze kerchief, while the young wife took the gold ring from her finger and played with it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Bir tomchi suv dengizga aylangan bir kecha bo‘ldi. Shu kambag‘al, bebuzat oilaning issiq va halol quchog‘iga qishloq qizlari va yosh juvonlarning hammasi deyarlik to‘plandi.
en: Suddenly she brought the gold ring up to her eye, turned it here and there, and after giving it a good look, she reached over to Umrinisabibi and put it on her little finger.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bevosita qo‘shni bo‘lgan xonadonlarning «oshini oshab, yoshini yashagan» kampirlari ham chiqishdilar.
en: Thinking and thinking, Umrinisabibi, without even remotely sensing its value, stared intently at this gold ring that had made its way from a stranger’s hand to her own.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu kecha, hatto, shahar qizlariga poyloqchi bo‘lib kelgan uyquchi kampirga ham jon kirdi.
en: When she came to, realizing what an expensive little thing this was and what she had just won for her daughter Bahri, her cheeks turned crimson from joy.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning jonlanganini ko‘rganlar ixtiyorsiz yoyilib kular va chin ko‘ngildan sevinardilar.
en: She quickly took the ring from her finger and wrapped it securely in her kerchief.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir emas, ikki dutor va ikki yaxshi dutorchi, bir nechta o‘yinchi, Zebixondan boshqa yana ikkita ovozi durustgina yosh juvonlar kelishdi.
en: “Now, speak, auntie!” “I’m surprised at what I’m about to say. You’ve invited guests.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Dasturxonga qaragan kishi bo‘lmadi; hech kim bu faqir va sodda hashamat ichida takalluf axtarmas, ko‘ngilning xursandliklarga bo‘lgan ketsiz maylini qondirish bilangina ovora edi.
en: Now, somehow, you’ll have to take back your invitation. You’ll have to keep this a secret from your co-wives.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuning uchun bo‘lsa kerak, dasturxon ustida duv-duv gaplashib, ayvonni ovozga to‘ldirib o‘tirgan kiz-juvonlardan hech biri o‘ng biqinida yonmayon  o‘tirib, zo‘rg‘a dasturxonga qo‘l uzatgan mingboshi oyimlarning «shu ham mehmondorchilikmi?» degan ma’nida bir-biriga qarab lab burishtirganlarini payqamadi.
en: It’s good that your co-wife’s daughter didn’t do the inviting. Had she, that would have been irreparable.” “Damn me, Zebi’s voice was such ecstasy that I couldn’t think of anything!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Dasturxon yig‘ilgandan keyin bazm boshlandi; shundan keyin hamma o‘zini unutdi, hamma yosh bolaga aylandi.
en: I asked my co-wife’s daughter: ‘should you invite them or should I?’ Look at me! Thank God, she was so conscientious.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uch ovozlik qizga yana bir nechtasi qo‘shilib, yalla ohangi ko‘klarga ko‘tarilgandan keyin kishlokning past-past, yiqiq-yoriq devorlaridan osongina oshib o‘tib, bitta-yarimta yigit-yalang ham to‘plana boshladi.
en: She told me, ‘I can’t have guests without my mother’s permission. You invite them.’” “Well, if you think about it, she too acted foolishly.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ular xira yongan chirog‘chaning yorug‘i zo‘rg‘a-zo‘rg‘a yetadigan joylarda — ayvonning ikki yonida cho‘nqayib o‘tirishgan, nafaslarini ichlariga olgan edilar.
en: But now her foolishness is your gain.” Umrinisabibi was silent for a moment and then again bent down.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ular orasida Xolmat bilan aravakash bola ham bor, ular ikkovi katta tut yog‘ochiga suyanib, tikka turardilar.
en: “Now you somehow pretend that you have fallen ill, I’ll go and tell Enaxon.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xolmat havas bilan qiziqib qarasa-da, uning ko‘ngli tamom betaraf edi, faqat aravakash yigit shuncha to‘polon-yalla orasida Zebining ovozidan boshqa ovozlarni, nechiqdir, farq etolmasdi.
en: I’ll tell her that if you get better, I’ll let her know myself. That should do it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U ovozni eshitish bilan ko‘nglining chuqur joylaridan xuruj qilib kelgan allaqanday totli bir sevinchi yashirolmadi:
en: Tomorrow or the next day the guests will leave anyways. Zebi is the daughter of that strict Razzoq-sufi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Zebinisaning ovozini aytaman, Xolmat aka...
en: They say he only let her out for one or two days, no more.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi u, o‘zi shu so‘zni aytganidan keyin, negadir, bir oz qizara tushib, yerga qaradi.
en: …” The young wife had still not come to and once again threw herself on Umrinisabibi’s neck.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Chakki emas!

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi Xolmat.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra so‘radi: — Oti Zebinisami? — Ha, Zebinisaxon!
en: Word will spread through the whole village … Will my co-wives really not say a word?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yigitchaning shu «xon» degan qo‘shimchasida «mening Zebinisam» degan ma’noda bir maqtanish, bir g‘urur ohangi bor edi.
en: If we could just find some other way. …” The young wife looked deeply into Umrinisabibi’s eyes again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu ohang juda ochiq eshitilgan bo‘lsa kerakki, Xolmat darhol fahmiga bordi va «a, haromi-ey!» deganday qilib unga qaragach:
en: “If we said that my mother is ill, that would be fine by me!” “Ok, we’ll make your mother the ill one. She’ll send for you urgently, you’ll ask forgiveness of your guests, and leave for her.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yurakdan urgan ekan-a!.. — dedi.
en: Then you’ll stay with her until the city girls leave.”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yigitcha bu so‘zdan o‘ng‘aysizlandi va tona boshladi:
en: “How will we do it?” “That’s easy enough.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yo‘g‘-e, ovozi soz deyman-da, ovozi!
en: I’ll put on my paranji and head over to your mother’s.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi, lekin tili gapirgani bilan yuragi «yolg‘on, yolg‘on» deb turganini o‘zi ham bilar, Xolmatning ishonmasligiga aqli yetardi.
en: I’ll explain everything to her and return right away. A person will come not long after me for you, and you’ll leave with him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuning uchun masalani chuqurlashtirmasdan, so‘zni boshqa tomongaroq burishni ep ko‘rdi: — Ovoziga nima deysiz, chinakam qiyomat-a? — dedi Xolmatga
en: Later tonight I’ll go and tell Enaxon.” The young wife was finally satisfied with this plan and kissed Umrinisabibi above her eyes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, ovozi joyida. Saltanatxondi o‘rtog‘imi?
en: “I’ll never forget this favor of yours, auntie,” she said.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Eng yaqin o‘rtog‘i. — Kimning qizi o‘zi?
en: “I’ll prepare your daughter’s wedding and, if God wills it, give her away myself!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Razzoq so‘fi degan bir odamning... — Razzoq so‘fi?
en: Go now!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, Razzoq so‘fi. Xudo bergan lekin so‘figa!
en: Here, there’s bread in the bowl and raisins on the plate, take these and go.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Xaridori ham ko‘pdir? — Sovchining ko‘pligidan ostonasi yeyilib ketgan, deydilar...
en: Be quick, dear auntie!” Umrinisabibi jumped up, took the food in her kerchief, and exited the house.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bilmadik, qaysi tolei balandga nasib bo‘lar ekan!
en: As she left through the courtyard, the young wife saw her off from the threshold.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Xudodan tilab turing, «noumid shayton», degan gap bor... Shu so‘zlarni ayta turib, Xolmat ham yigitchaga shayton qarashi bilan qaradi.
en: One of her co-wives outside probably asked Umrinisabibi what she was doing in the house and for that reason she set one foot back in the courtyard and cried out, “Sultonxon has invited guests for tomorrow, I’m leaving to see to it!” Sultonxon quite liked that loud and harsh voice.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu vaqtda ashulachi qizlar yalladan to‘xtadilar, ingichka-yo‘g‘on ayol ovozlaridan iborat kuchlik bir xorning:
en: ... The mingboshi’s middle wife, Poshshaxon, was overjoyed to hear that the singer girl would soon be their guest.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bor bo‘lsinlar!
en: But her husband had already left for the city.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — degan olqishi yuksaldi. Erkaklar o‘z olqishlarini ichlarida saqlamoqqa majbur edilar.
en: She knew well that if he were home it wouldn’t be difficult for him, having heard that city girl’s voice, to add himself a new wife.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ularning to‘planganlarini bir-ikkita kampirdan boshqa hech kim bilmas edi.
en: Her husband’s womanizing was well known not just to her, but also the whole country.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yalla bitgach, ba’zi kizlar o‘rinlaridan turib, u yoq-bu yoqqa jilishdilar, ba’zilari o‘choq boshiga choy olgali ketdilar, ba’zilari joylarini almashtirib, yaqin ko‘rgan o‘rtoqlarining yonlariga o‘tib o‘tirdilar.
en: She didn’t hesitate to ally with her former enemy, her elder co-wife Xadichaxon, to somehow give Zebi to her husband. It must have been for that reason that she had breakfast in Xadichaxon’s home, and pretending to tell Xadichaxon the most mahram of secrets, she tried to win the older woman to her side.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi erkaklar ham o‘zlarini orqaroq olmoqqa majbur edilar, ular ham jilishdilar.
en: “No word from our husband so far?” she asked, smiling. “Yes, our husband spent the night in the city.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mehmonlardan Qumrixon birdaniga tutning tagiga borib qolib, u yerda ikki erkakning o‘ziga qarab kulib turganini ko‘rgach, «voy, o‘la qolay!» deb, uyalib orqaga qaytdi.
en: Do you think he had a look at another girl or two?” “Will his eyes ever be sated? Their glance always seems to fall on still others.” “Do you really think our will has anything to do with it?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yana Saltining yoniga borib o‘tirgach, pichirlabgina:
en: God made him that way.” “God must so like these men. …”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Tevaragimizni shundoqqina qishloq yigitlari o‘rab olishibdi.
en: “And what about us? Are there any among us that don’t like them?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bilmasdan tutning tagiga borib qolsam, ikkitasi menga qarab baqrayib turibdi...
en: Take some bread! Here’s some jam.” “We have bread and jam every day.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bittasi o‘zimizning aravakashmi...
en: Let’s talk of other worries.” “But not everyone has bread and jam.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu vaqtda bu ikkala qizning nimalar deb pichirlashayotganidan vasvasaga tushgan Zebi sekingina bo‘ynini cho‘zib, gapga quloq soldi.
en: Only those that have it have it. We should be grateful.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: faqat Qumrining so‘zini — «bittasi o‘zimizning aravakash...» degan so‘nggi so‘zini eshitib oldi.
en: …” “A thousand times thanks be to God, of course. … You know yourself, you’ve experienced it … something that scrapes at the heart.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yuragi o‘ynadi... va darhol burilib tashqariga qaradi.
en: …” “My heart, dear, has been so scraped that there’s nothing left.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Chirog‘ning xira yorug‘ida kampirlarning ivirsib yurganlarini ko‘rdi.
en: The flame in my heart is nothing but a dried-up wick. Now, as God wills it, you’ll live through what I have.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Boshqa hech narsa ko‘rinmasdi. Yurak o‘ynashi bosilmadi.
en: Truth be told, my dear, I wouldn’t wish my suffering on another.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lablari titramoqqa boshlagan edi... Birdaniga o‘rnidan turdi; qizlar yo‘l bo‘shatdilar, ularni oralab o‘tdi.
en: Take some bread.” Poshshaxon felt the bitter, sharp feelings behind her co-wife’s words as spears that pierced right through her breast.
