uz: Xadichaxon esa ezildi, kuydi, o‘rtandi, xo‘rlanib-xo‘rlanib achchiq-achchiq yig‘ladi.
en: He forgot other things, but not this. The elders of the village, talking among themselves, said that no previous khan had ever ruled their land so long.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat hali bo‘yida bo‘lmay turib, o‘zining peshonasiga ham kundosh bitdi. Butun g‘ururi sindi, gerdayishi poymol bo‘ldi, sevinchi so‘ndi, yuzi so‘ldi, lablari xazon rangiga bo‘yaldi, umidlari uzildi, oyoqlari zo‘rg‘a-zo‘rg‘a sudralib jiladigan holga keldi.
en: Mallaxon, Xudoyor, Nasriddinbek, and the like had come and gone seemingly with every movement of the spring clouds. But Akbarali mingboshi had now thirteen years occupied his post, and all the while his wealth, esteem, and power grew unabatingly.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sultonxon kelgandan beri uning lablari ikki tishi orasidan chiqmas, ko‘zlari sal narsaga yosh olib yuborar, ko‘kragidagi devlar irg‘itgan og‘ir toshlardan biri ko‘ndalang kelib yotardi...
en: “God granted him to us, God!” said the elders. “God told him, ‘Take it, my servant,’ and that’s all there was to it.” Some of the youth couldn’t help themselves: “God gives to such unjust people!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Durust, qorni to‘q, ust-boshi joyida, qavat-qavat sarpo, og‘ir mehnat yo‘q... Lekin yonginasida boshqa bir yulduz charaqlab, ko‘zlarini qamashtirib turgandan keyin bu davlatlardan nima foyda?
en: Why does he not throw us poor a little something?!” Having heard this, the elders ran after the youth, brandishing sticks, and the youth fled.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xadichaxonning bu haqli kesatishlaridan keyin cho‘kkan og‘ir bir jimlik ichida faqat og‘izlargina quruq nonni chaynashdan chaloplar ekan, Poshshaxon bu nar-salarni o‘ylardi.
en: “Why are you running? God will give you yours, come and get it!” The elders well knew that this wealth, esteem, and power weren’t granted by God to a simple and coarse person that could hardly form a sentence without Miryoqub’s help.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bugun o‘zining eski dushmani oldida dushmanning haq ekanini iqror qilish, albatta, yengil emasidi.
en: The greetings and bows that Miryoqub received every time he appeared on the street were no less than those given to the mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat narigi
en: In fact, they were probably more.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — kichik kundosh, mingboshining kumush kamarida eng a’lo naqsh bo‘lib yonib turganda, bu zararsiz kundoshing haqligini iqror qilib va uning siniq ko‘nglini ovlash, shu bilan uni qo‘lga olmoq, hozir ikkala xotin uchun baravar kundosh bo‘lgan kichik xotinga qarshi o‘t ochmoq lozim edi.
en: Mingboshi was very rarely seen on the street, and when he was, it was at night behind several guards; during the day, he only went out in his gold-brocade robe to see the city’s notables on his thoroughbred. No one strained themselves too much greeting and bowing to him because bending over once every month or, hell, once in ten days is no hard thing.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bo‘shalgan piyolani chertib, uzatarkan:
en: But Miryoqub was always on his feet and always on the streets.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Aytganingiz rost, — dedi Poshshaxon, — aytgan gaplaringiz achchiq bo‘lsa hamki, rost.
en: Most of the time he walked, but he was always in a hurry. If you offered him an “Assalom alaykum!” you would only receive a “Vaalaykum” in return, probably because he was hurrying .
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu to‘g‘rida men sizga hech narsa deyolmayman, ayniqsa, men kelganda bolalik edingiz siz...
en: If he turned his head in your direction and greeted you, it was always with a glance of his smiling eyes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bilaman.
en: Your back really would give out bowing to this “real mingboshi” whose business took him every which where at all hours of the day. Unlike their previous efforts at nicknaming—they called a local grocer “European grocer”—the village elders weren’t mistaken in awarding Miryoqub the moniker “Miryoqub the sly.” They justified their choice with ease: “nothing comes out right if his hand hasn’t touched it.” The mingboshi owned so much land and water that he himself couldn’t keep track of his holdings.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kundoshining qo‘lidan sovibroq qolgan bir piyola choyni oldi-da, birbir  ketin ikki-uch ho‘plab, bo‘shalgan piyolani yana qaytardi.
en: But although God had granted his favorite servant such wealth and supported him in everything, He left him in arrears regarding children.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra davom etdi: — U yog‘ini o‘ylaganda, na sizda ayb bor, na menda.
en: In fact, he had no children other than his eldest wife’s daughter, Fazilat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qaysi birimiz bu odamga o‘zimiz xoxdab tegibmiz?
en: To whom would he leave all that wealth?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hammamizni ota-onamiz bizdan so‘ramay-netmay uzatgan.
en: To his childless wives, to complete strangers?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bizning ko‘z yoshlarimizga kim qaragan,
en: His constant marriages must have been his strategy to rectify the inheritance problem, but even then, he had no luck. Sequestering himself alone in his house, where not even a shadow could hear him, he would tell himself: “that damn girl better not be from another man.” Miryoqub, as mingboshi got older, sometimes asked himself: “was it not mingboshi’s hopeless situation that caused his womanizing?” One day at noyib to’ra’s, they were sitting with the host drinking when noyib to’ra’s wife unexpectedly brought their grandson in.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: deysiz? Shu yerda Xadichaxon e’tiroz qildi:
en: He was golden-haired, round like a watermelon, chubby, and white like cotton.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yo‘q, unday demang.
en: Mingboshi suddenly took the boy in his hands, and, despite the boy being an infidel and a Russian, embraced him closely and kissed him. The boy must have been frightened by the mingboshi’s unpleasant face because he started sobbing uncontrollably.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Men, o‘zim xohlab tekkanman.
en: They took the boy out.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U vaqtda kuyovingiz yosh edi, muncha katta amaldor emasidi, nihoyati ellikboshi edi.
en: Immediately after, mingboshi poured himself a full glass of vodka, downed it, and then another, and another.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Birinchi xotinidan bola bo‘lmagan ekan, ikki-uch yil umr qilishganlaridan keyin xotini o‘lib ketgan.
en: Miryoqub’s nudging, gesturing, the hosts’ reprimands and later threats—none of it had any effect. Once mingboshi was completely inebriated, he asked them to bring the boy in again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Meni olgan vaqtida: «Sen ko‘z ochib ko‘rganimsan», derdi...
en: His mother had no desire to give her little lamb to a drunk, but mingboshi began to beg. He even started weeping.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mening hech bir noliydigan yerim yo‘q edi. Toleimdan xafa emas edim, bu orada mana bu Fazilat tug‘ildi.
en: Noyib to’ra ordered that the boy be woken up and delivered, but mingboshi had already lost consciousness and collapsed on the divan by the time the boy came in.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bola degan ota-onani bir-biriga bog‘laydi... Fazilat tug‘ilgandan keyin men juda xursand edim.
en: Deprived of both child and wits but buried in land, water, money, and other riches, mingboshi was entirely in Miryoqub’s hands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xuddi o‘sha paytlarda onam o‘ldi. Otam hajga ketib, u yerda qoldi.
en: Mingboshi never knew the amount of the harvest that came from his lands nor how much made its way to Miryoqub’s coffers.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shuncha musibatlarni qiynalmasdan o‘tkazdim.
en: When necessary, mingboshi actually asked Miryoqub for money.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nimaga desangiz, uyimdan ko‘nglim to‘q edi...
en: If his household needed flour, rice, meat, oil, or anything else, Miryoqub took care of it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu yerga kelganda, Xadichaxon ko‘ziga yosh oldi, shapaloq gulli obiravon ko‘ylagining uzun yengi bilan ko‘zlarini artdi.
en: Mingboshi, who since receiving his appointment knew nothing but life’s pleasures, never asked Miryoqub how he managed. Miryoqub would hardly have earned the name “sly” if all his work had been for mingboshi alone.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra yoshli ko‘zlari bilan tash-qaridagi so‘rida ochiq-sochiq yotgan va boshiga oftob tushib qolgan Fazilatga qaradi.
en: He received the name because there was no profitable opportunity that he didn’t have his hands in. In the village there were two groceries , a butcher shop; and, in the district, two teahouses.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Choynakdagi so‘nggi ikki ho‘plam choyni quyib, bir hamlada ichib bitirib, choynak-piyolani narigi yoniga olib qo‘yganidan keyin so‘zida davom qildi:
en: People in the know said that four of the five ran by Miryoqub’s initiative alone. In the city, a new cotton factory had recently opened shop along the main road.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Buningiz amaldor bo‘lgandan keyin aynidi. Mingboshilik yomon hovliqtirdi.
en: Its warehouses were so big that at harvest time the cotton had to be weighed on three scales.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘z qishlog‘ini tashlab, bu yerga ko‘chdi.
en: They said that Miryoqub was a shareholder in that factory.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu katta hovlini sotib oldi.
en: It couldn’t have been a coincidence that his two-wheeled yellow phaeton and chestnut mare were usually hitched there. He was a member of one of the big banks’ auditing commissions and conducted meetings once a week in that capacity.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mana bu katta imoratlarni soldirdi.
en: On top of that, no one ever saw him pay the smallest of taxes or buy one license.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bog‘-rog‘ qildi, yer-suv ko‘paytirdi.
en: What kind of misfortunes didn’t occur with mingboshi?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘ngli boshqa savdolarga, o‘zga ko‘ylarga tushdi...
en: What kind of strange accusations written by skilled lawyers didn’t bring investigators over to mingboshi?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bola ham ko‘ziga ko‘rinmadi, xotin ham.
en: How many times did the district governor call him in?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yoniga "haybarakallachilar" kirishdi. Xotin topadigan, maslahat beradiganlar ko‘payishdi.
en: In such times mingboshi, taught well by Miryoqub, always answered “I don’t know” and denied any fault in the matter.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir haftaning ichida to‘y qilib, mening ustimga sizni keltirib qo‘ydi...
en: And while those official interrogations were conducted, Miryoqub always conducted a few of his own unofficial ones.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu yerga kelganda, Poshshaxon chidayolmadi:
en: After staying in the city for one or two days, he would return to the village, having cleared mingboshi of all charges. If mingboshi went to one of the Russian nobles, Miryoqub, of course, accompanied him, and no one ever asked, “Why is he here?” After all, Miryoqub wasn’t an official and wasn’t a secretary or interpreter for mingboshi, nor did he even know Russian.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Men xohlab kelgan bo‘lsam ekan...
en: Why did he always follow mingboshi like a tail? Why?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Oyog‘imdan bog‘lab, bir cho‘riday olib keldilar.
en: Miryoqub spent a good part of his time at mingboshi’s home, though his house was in the same village.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tug‘ilganimga, yoshligimda kasal bo‘lib o‘lib ketmaganimga o‘kina-o‘kina kelganman.
en: They say that his house was guarded every night by one or two policemen, only no one had ever seen them, and even if they had seen them, they wouldn’t, no, couldn’t talk about it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bilaman, aylanay, bilaman...
en: ... One day Miryoqub was at noyib to’ra’s house.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U yog‘ini so‘rasangiz, bu ayol toifasining ko‘pi ota-onaning zo‘ri bilan erga tegadi.
en: The gift he had brought this time must have finally so impressed the nobleman that the latter sat him down and talked of several things.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunday bo‘lsa ham siz menga kundosh bo‘lib kelgansiz-da... — Kelmay o‘la qolay men!
en: When the noble’s tongue tired and the first signs of a yawn appeared on Miryoqub’s face, a person came in from outside.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sizga kundosh bo‘lib necha yil, necha oyim rohatda o‘tdi?
en: On his shoulders were two gold hammers; he was tall and had a greying beard and thick mustache.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siz-ku besh-olti yil rohat ko‘ribsiz, armoningiz yo‘q...
en: His smiling face was marred by one eye that was constantly squinting.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Men sho‘rlik bir yil ham yayraganim yo‘q... Bir kechaning ichida to‘y
en: He was most certainly one of those educated engineers common in Turkestan.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: ovozi chiqdi-yu, ertasi quni namozshomda Sultonxon kirib keldi... O‘lganim yaxshi emasmi bu kunimdan?
en: He exchanged pleasantries with noyib to’ra, but said nothing to Miryoqub and quickly moved towards the table in front of him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Otam o‘lgur muning yer-suviga, davlatiga qiziqdi, "yax"4 deb turib oldi.
en: The guest attempted, unsuccessfully, to move the chair with a powerful jerk of his hand. He then looked at his watch and threw himself down on the chair.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu davlatlardan unga nima foyda?.. — Davlati qursin, davlati!..
en: Noyib to’ra gestured at Miryoqub and turned to his guest, “Are you acquainted with our Miryoqub, my friend?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Enaxonning kelinbibisiga rashkim keladi...
en: He is a rare one!” The guest lightly nodded in Miryoqub’s direction.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Davlat asari yo‘q.
en: Miryoqub smiled, revealing his irritation and injured pride, while the engineer, a moment ago smiling, suddenly scowled. Noyib to’ra must have sensed this, and laughed softly and warmly, glancing at Miryoqub as a loving father looks at his favorite son.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ro‘zg‘orlari zo‘rg‘a o‘tadi.
en: Miryoqub, like a pampered son, answered noyib to’ra with a smile.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qo‘zichoqday ikki bolasi bor. Eri hamisha yonida...
en: With that, the curtain descended on Miryoqub’s participation in the interaction, and the two Russians talked among themselves.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kundosh alami yo‘q...
en: The engineer hummed and hummed like a nightingale!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nimasini aytasiz... Ikkovi ham jim bo‘ldilar.
en: Miryoqub knew that lawyers were a talkative bunch, but he never expected such garrulity from an engineer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir ozdan so‘ng gapni yana Poshshaxon boshladi:
en: Gradually, he started to catch something of their Russian conversation.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Men chidolmayman aslo, men chidolmayman! Men aslo chidolmayman bu alamga!
en: When noyib to’ra noticed that Miryoqub was listening intently, he started to orate in a fine tone, perhaps to match the guest’s.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra jalanglab tevaragiga qarab olgach, dasturxon ustidan kundoshiga egilib, dedi:
en: At that point, our Miryoqub stretched out his hand and took a large book from the table.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yana bittani olib berib, mana bu yashshamagurni qonqora qaqshatsam...
en: The book was full of pictures. He began to leaf through it noiselessly.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kibru havolarini sindirsam...
en: The nobleman forgot Miryoqub as if he wasn’t there at all.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shashtini qaytarsam...
en: Only when a few slurs about sarts came from the engineer’s mouth, did noyib to’ra direct at Miryoqub his fatherly glance. Even though Miryoqub’s eyes were on the book, his ears, like a snake stalking its prey, were fully on the conversation.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Boshqa gaplar allaqachon esidan chiqib ketgan...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Xudoyo «ol, qulim», desa, hech gap emas. Shundayda ba’zi bir yosh-yalanglar:

uz: — deb qolishadi. Buni eshitgan keksalar tayoq ko‘tarib, yosh-yalang ustiga yugurishadi, bechora yoshlar tayoqdan o‘zlarini olib qocharkan, bir-birlariga qarab piching otishadi:
en: Am I in charge, or is she?” “You yourself said, ‘Fine, do what the eshon’s wife says,’ did you not?” “To hell with what she says.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nimaga qochasan? Xudo senga ham berayotir, olmaysanmi?..

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yurtning keksalari butun bu davlat, hukumat va ulug‘likning — bir og‘iz gapini silliq va yoqimli qilib gapirolmaydigan sodda va to‘ng odamga birdaniga «nasib va ro‘zi» bo‘lib qolishida Miryoqub akaning katta hunari bor ekanini yaxshi bilishadi.
en: What could she say to this enraged man who yesterday entrusted his daughter to the eshon’s wife and today curses her?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun Miryoqub aka ko‘chakuyda  ko‘ringanda, unga beriladigan salom va qilinadigan ta’zimlar, mingboshinikidan kam bo‘lmaydi.
en: Nevertheless, Qurvonbibi, taking the defense of her daughter upon her shoulders, was forced to come up with an answer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat shu qadarisi borki, mingboshi u yoq-bu yoqqa juda kam yuradi, yursa ham mirshablarini orqasiga ergashtirib, kechasi yuradi; kunduzlari bo‘lsa, faqat shahardagi ulug‘vor chaqirtirganda, zarbof choponlarini kiyib va tatti samanni yo‘rg‘alatib o‘tadi.
en: “Can’t she enjoy herself for three or four days after being locked up here all winter? You yourself don’t come home for days at a time!” “If she becomes like me, then let her go where she wants to!” screamed Razzoq-sufi in reply.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Unga salom berish va ta’zim qilishdan bellarga og‘irlik kelmaydi: chunki oyda bir, o‘n kunda bir egilib qo‘yish hech gap emas.
en: The old woman didn’t yield, and raised her voice: “If a woman were like you, could she really go wherever she wanted?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ammo Miryoqub akaning yurishi ko‘p!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U, aksari, piyoda yuradi, yurganda ham negadir shoshilib yuradi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Assalomu alaykum!», deb dona-dona qilib salom bersangiz, shoshilganidan bo‘lsa kerak, «vass...», debgina qo‘yadi. Shu bilan birga, siz tomonga bo‘ynini qiyshaytirib, juda kichiklik bilan alik oladi, doim kulimsirab turgan ko‘zlarini siz tomonga qiyagina bir tashlab olib, yo‘rg‘alaganicha ketadi...
en: Or do you want your daughter to die of consumption from being cooped up all the time?” These irate voices that were reaching their peak carried to Zebi in the courtyard, only increasing her unease.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Jinqarchaday hammavaqt va har qayda ko‘rinib qoladigan bu «asl mingboshi»ga salom bermoqdan bellaringiz toladi...
en: She could no longer stand it: she got up from the platform and sat down by the window of her father’s room.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Do‘konidan har narsa topiladigan bir baqqolga «farang baqqol» deb nom qo‘ygan keksalar har ishda qo‘li bo‘lgan bu odamga «Miryoqub epaqa» laqabini berib, xato qilmaganlar.
en: Now the voices in the house chased after her ears, giving them no respite. “Don’t talk nonsense, Fitna!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zlari ham bu laqabning

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: to‘g‘riligini osongina isbot qiladilar: — U aralashmagan ish epaqaga kelmaydi...
en: Don’t make me mad!” Qurvonbibi knew well that her husband had a temper.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshining yer-suvi shu qadar ko‘pki, hisobini o‘zi ham bilmaydi.

author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lekin xudo bu sevgili quliga davlatni ikki qo‘llab uzatsa-da, farzand to‘g‘risida bir oz o‘ksitib qo‘ygan.
en: The old woman softened her voice and, suppressing her anger as much as she could, said: “Ok, fine, I won’t scream.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Darhaqiqat, katta xotinidan bo‘lgan qizi Fazilatdan boshqa uning farzandi yo‘q.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: …” Her mother’s suddenly calm voice may have soothed Zebi’s worries temporarily , but now that the conversation had turned to her, her stress increased tenfold.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — «Bu qiz o‘lgur ham boshqadan bo‘lmasin...» deb qo‘yadi...

uz: So‘ngra noyibning amri bilan bolani uyg‘otib keltirdilar.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat bu vaqtda mingboshi o‘zidan ketib, divanga ag‘anagan edi...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yerdan chiqqan hosilning qanchasi o‘z qo‘liga kirib, qanchasi Miryoqub omboriga to‘kilganini mingboshi o‘zi hech qachon bilgan emas.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kerak bo‘lganda, mingboshi Miryoqubdan pul so‘rab olar, un, gurunch, go‘sht, yog‘ va ro‘zg‘orning boshqa keraklarini bo‘lsa ichkarining talabiga qarab yana

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub tayyorlab berar, shu uchun jonning rohatidan boshqani bilmagan mingboshi undan narisini surishtirmas edi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqubning topishi yolg‘iz shu mingboshi orqali bo‘lsa, unga «epaqa» nomini qo‘yish to‘g‘ri bo‘larmidi? Miryoqubning qilmagan ishi yo‘qligidan shu nomni bergan edilar.
en: The large house of mingboshi … the extravagant gatherings … the two co-wives who had appeared so friendly with one another … Sultonxon’s sudden disappearance.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qishloqda ikkita baqqollik, bitta qassoblik do‘koni, guzarda ikkita samovar bor. Bilgan odamlar bu besh muassasadan to‘rti Miryoqubning kuchi bilan aylanganini so‘zlaydilar.
en: … Then everything she had heard about mingboshi began to ring in her ears: he was an incorrigible womanizer.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shaharda katta yo‘lning bo‘yiga — qo‘rg‘on tashqarisiga bir yangi paxta zavodi tushdi, zavodning kattakon bir paxta saroyi ham bor-ki, paxta terim vaqtida uch tarozi bilan paxta oladi.
en: … With three wives, he was only able to father one daughter. … From the pain of childlessness, he had become the cause of all kinds of misfortune.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ana o‘sha zavodga ham Miryoqubni sherik, deydilar.
en: … Power, wealth, fine things bring him no happiness.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Voqean, uning ikki g‘ildirakli sariq faytonchasi va sariq yo‘rg‘asi aksar zavod oldida bog‘langan bo‘ladi.
en: … He was ugly as death, repulsive. … Those who saw him were frightened.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shahardagi katta bankalardan birida «uchyot qo‘mitasi»ning a’zosi, haftada bir majlis o‘tkazadi...
en: … And yet he had such pretty and tender wives. … What poor things.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu bilan birga, uning biror joyga chaqa soliq to‘laganini, biror kasbga biror marta «qizil qog‘oz» (patent) olganini hech kim bilmaydi. Mingboshining boshiga ne qora kunlar kelmadi!
en: … Suddenly she remembered Saltanat’s behavior in the cart: Saltanat had cried out, “Mingboshi!” She had become pale and lost consciousness.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yaxshi advokatlar tomonidan bitilgan g‘alati arizalar qanday tergovchilarni keltirmadi! Qanday zo‘r to‘ralar chaqirib so‘ramadilar!
en: When she opened her eyes and stared at everyone, she then looked directly at Zebi and threw herself into her arms.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hokim necha martalar g‘azab bilan chaqirtirmadi! Unday vaqglarda mingboshi Miryoqubning ta’limi bilan hamma savollarga «bilmayman», deb javob berar yoki biror aybisnod  qilinsa, tonib tura berardi.
en: Then two days ago, Saltanat’s mother had come and conducted a conversation in whispers with her mother.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Rasmiy so‘roqlar bu xilda borganda, orqadan Miryoqub g‘ayrirasmiy yo‘llar bilan so‘roq berar, bir-ikki kun shaharda qolib, qishloqqa qaytganida, mingboshining ustidan har qanday og‘ir tog‘ ham ag‘anagan bo‘lardi.
en: Since then, her mother had looked like she was constantly mourning. Oh, if only Saltanat were with her now!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi qaysi bir to‘ranikiga borsa, Miryoqub, albatta, birgalashib boradi; «bu nimaga kerak?» deb so‘ragan odam yo‘q.
en: She could have shared these things with her, and Saltanat would have comforted her, right?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Axir, Miryoqub amaldor bo‘lmasa, loaqal mingboshiga mirza yo tilmoch bo‘lmasa, o‘zi o‘rus tilini tuzuk-quruq bilmasa... nega munaqa mingboshining ketidan elchib yurardi?
en: Did Saltanat already know? Wouldn’t she have said something in the cart if she knew?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nega? Miryoqubning ko‘p umri mingboshinikida o‘tadi, o‘zining hovlisi ham shu qishloqning o‘zida-ku, lekin chekkaroq joyda.
en: They talked the whole way, and she didn’t say anything about this.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kechalari uning hovlisida bir-ikki mirshabning poyloqchilik qilib chiqqanini gapiradilar, faqat muni o‘z ko‘zi bilan ko‘rgan kishi yo‘q, bo‘lsa ham ochib gapirmaydi, yo... gapirolmaydi!
en: Or could she have been hiding it? If she was hiding it, was she really Zebi’s friend?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Bir kun Miryoqub noyib to‘raning uyida edi.
en: What kind of friend is that?

Mingboshi repeatedly opened the newspaper, read a few lines, and wrinkled it in his grip, continuously asking, “Where is Miryoqub?” Every time he asked, Mirzabobo would run out to the gates, look around, and return.

uz: Ha!..

uz: — Men to‘y qilmoqchiman... — Sen?

uz: Kimga?

uz: — Sizga!

uz: Menga? — Ha, sizga.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qo‘y endi, bitta-bitta gapirib ber: nima gap o‘zi?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub yaqin o‘tirib, so‘zlay boshladi:

uz: — Shaharda bir xudo bandasining ikkala dunyoga arziydigan bir qizi bor ekan!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi erkin-erkin kuldi:

uz: Astag‘furullo, de!

uz: Mingboshi besh battar yoyilib kuldi. — A, battol-ey!

uz: O, battol-ey!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi u. Miryoqub asta-asta davom etdi:

uz: — Xolmatnikida.

uz: — Shu Xolmatnikida? Shu o‘zimizning Xolmatnikida-ya?

uz: U bechora ochidan o‘lolmay yuribdi, mehmon chaqirib nima qilar ekan?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Shuning uchun siz chaqirtirsangiz, Xolmat ham xursand bo‘ladi, mehmonlari ham.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Eshitaylik...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqubning qulog‘iga egildi

Why did they write about me?” “You haven’t heard how they praised Abdusamat mingboshi?” “Ah, you mean last year?” “Yes, last year.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Kattaning rashki kelmas-a? — dedi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Eng kichigidan boshqa hech qaysisining rashki kelmaydi.

uz: Ovqatdan shu choqqacha darak bo‘lmadi. Sen o‘tiratur, ketib qolma!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ichkariga tomon asta bosib yura boshladi. Hali ham, boyagi odaticha, xursand bo‘lib kular va birushta:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Obbo, betavfiq-ey!.. — deb so‘zlanardi.

en: They would have written the same things about you if you hadn’t closed the school and just said yes to a few of their demands.” Mingboshi leaned over to Miryoqub and whispered, “Noyib to’ra wouldn’t allow it. What was I supposed to do?” “Noyib to’ra is a tricky one.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Miryoqub answered mingboshi’s smirk with a quip of his own: “What will you do? Hit him?” “Can you hit such a man?” Mingboshi clearly hadn’t thought through his suggestion.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra Xadichaxonning javob berishini kutib o‘tir-masdanoq:

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ovqating nima bo‘ldi?

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Men sizlarga non-choy chiqaraman.

uz: Mingboshi mehmonlarning o‘z uyida ekanini eshitib, hayron bo‘ldi: — Mehmonlar shu yerda?
en: …” “I told you already, you won’t even find his ghost around here.” “Then what can we do?” Miryoqub didn’t answer.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qachon kelishdi? — Namozshomga yaqin.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yaxshi, yaxshi. Bir ozdan so‘ng yana takror qildi:
en: After mingboshi repeated the question he spoke.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yaxshi. Yaxshi...
en: “What can you do, master?

uz: So‘ngra birdan: — Ashulachisi bormi, yo‘qmi?
en: You’ll just have to grind your teeth and endure.” Mingboshi shot up from his place.

uz: — deb so‘radi.
en: “You think I’m so impotent to just endure it, just take their blows?!” he said, raising his voice. “Get me my passport, I’ll just go to Mecca!” “Sit down, master!” said Miryoqub, having raised his voice some as well.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bor, — dedi Xadichaxon. — Ashula qilganda, meni chaqirtir!
en: “This isn’t something to be done with bile and screaming.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Durustmi?
en: Let’s think.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — shu so‘zni aytgach, xotinining javob berishini kutmasdanoq, burilib, tashqariga tomon yurdi.
en: We’ll find something.” Miryoqub got up and went to the porch; a teapot stood there, and, after pouring cold tea into a cup, he drank it in one gulp.

uz: Butun umrlarida deyarlik bunday sertakalluf ziyofatni ko‘rmagan yosh qizlar takallufga yarasha betakalluflik bilan, o‘lgudek quturib, o‘yin-kulgi qildilar.
en: He returned to his place and began speaking quicker and more assuredly than usual. “I saw the newspaper in the city and started thinking there.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Horib-charchab, zo‘rg‘a-zo‘rg‘a oyoq tashlab qo‘shxonalariga qaytgan vaqtlarida, yarim kechadan ancha o‘tib qolgan edi.
en: I haven’t been able to find an answer, so I’ve been laughing. It’s better to laugh than cry when you can’t cross a wide canal, you know?” “I know.”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uyda qolgan ikki kampirga — sahar turib, aravani qo‘shtirishga buyurdilar-da, o‘zlari ko‘zlarini yumar-yummas, og‘ir uyquga ketdilar.
en: “The hero who fails overcomes grief with laughter,” added Miryoqub.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bular yoshlikning beparvo quchog‘ida, ma’sum go‘daklarday, har narsadan xabarsiz, to‘libtoshib  uxlarkan, so‘ri tomon ikki kampirning tashvishli bir un bilan, allanega besaranjom bo‘lib pichirlashgani eshitilardi.
en: Mingboshi was quiet for a moment. “Whatever, we still have to do something.” This last sentence no longer sounded like the roar of an enraged beast, but rather the complaint of a cat doused in water.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ularning biri o‘zimiz bilgan Umrinisabibi bo‘lib, sevimli Zebining yosh umriga qasdlangan yomonlar to‘g‘risida gapirardi...
en: Miryoqub, still thinking, raised his head. “We’ll write a response in our newspaper.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Tong yorishmasdan yo‘lga tushib, qishloqdan chiqar-chiqmas ashulani baland qo‘ygan Zebi necha yillik g‘am-tashvishlardan to‘rt-besh kun ichida ortig‘i bilan yozi-lib kelarkan, o‘z orqasida o‘ynayotgan o‘yinlardan xabarsiz edi.
en: If the jadid mocked you in his newspaper, then we’ll praise you and revile him in ours. The scales will tip back in our favor.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kechasi Umrinisabibidan Zebi to‘g‘risidagi tashvishli xabarni eshitganidan keyin Enaxonning onasi mehmonlar javdishgan vaqtda Saltanatni bir chekaga chaqirib, haligi xususda ogohlantirgan bo‘lsa-da, Saltanat bu qadar yoyilib va quvnab borayotgan o‘rtog‘ini xafa qilmaslik uchun unga hech narsa demaslikni ep ko‘rdi.
en: Those trumpets that they’re playing for Abdusamat and the others will be nothing but reeds. That will be enough!” “Yes, great!” “You’re agreed?” Miryoqub made sure.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Saltanat u to‘g‘rida bu yosh qizga gap ochib, uning yorug‘ ta’bini xira qilmasdan, o‘z onasi orqali Zebining onasiga eshitdirib qo‘ymoqchi bo‘lardi.
en: “Agreed!” said mingboshi. “You’ll write it yourself?” “Do you think about what you’re saying, master?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshinikida juda sertakalluf ziyofat yegan bu yosh qiz ziyofat bergan juvonlardan juda minnatdor bo‘lmoq bilan birga, shunday qari va nihoyat darajada xunuk odamga, yana kundosh ustiga, tushib qolganlari uchun ularga chin ko‘ngildan achinardi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: We’ll find a writer, a man of the pen. I’ll do it when I go to the city.” “Fine,” said mingboshi, “just take care of it.” Then he got up from his seat and went over to Miryoqub, leaned down, and spoke directly into his ear.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qizlardan hech biri mingboshi xotinlarining davlatiga qiziqmagan, ularning tolelariga ko‘z olaytirmagan, u davlatlar to‘g‘risida o‘zaro gap ochilganda, ochiq jirkanish bilan, «Davlati boshidan qolsin!» deya qichqirgan edi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Respect is another thing, respect!” ... Two weeks after that conversation Miryoqub brought the government-run sart-language newspaper to mingboshi and silently handed it to his master.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ustida go‘yo xonatlas qo‘ylak, Xitoy tovardan kaltacha, toza beqasam kamzul, qimmatbaho shohi ro‘mol, amirkon kavish-mahsi... Keng hovlida, daranglagan ayvonlar va so‘lum uylarda, odamni chiroyli qilib ko‘rsatadigan qalin toshoynaklarning qarshisida...
en: The following letter was printed in it: After the delivery of warm greetings to the respected nobleman editor of the newspaper, I have the honor to announce that in the newspaper of the jadid class, a letter was printed in which undignified addresses were directed towards Akbarali mingboshi.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tilla bilak-uzuklar, yoqut ko‘zli uzuklar, xina bilan cho‘g‘day lovullab turgan barmoqdar,
en: In answer to this impertinence it is incumbent upon us to comment with regard to the truth. For nearly fourteen years, Akbarali mingboshi has served His Highness the White

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Haligi nokning eng to‘lganini olish uchun dasturxonga qo‘l uzatar ekan, qo‘lini boshqa bir qo‘l kelib ushlaydi...
en: As concerns the uncouth schoolteacher, he appeared only petty and miserable to our citizenry. He, no doubt, is impious and ignorant of his duties as a Muslim.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: He told the students of his school such things contrary to the teachings of Islam. For example, that the earth is round, that is to say like a watermelon, as a result of which the citizenry became upset and caused disturbances.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: The esteemed Akbarali mingboshi, in the interests of the protection of our land’s general peace, closed said teacher’s school.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: Rich and poor, teachers and students, imams, eshons, and murids are grateful for his conscientiousness and foresight and direct their prayers for His Highness the White Tsar and his representative, the governor-general because they have appointed as their servitors in our land such lovers of justice and truth, such protectors of order.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra asta-sekin ko‘zini ochgach, hammaga bir-bir qarab oldi; uning bu qarashlarida og‘ir bir horg‘inlik boridi...

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Zebixon! Jonim Zebixon!!

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deya uni mahkam quchog‘iga oldi... Qizlar hayron, hammasining ko‘zi ularda.
en: Maybe he won’t need a translation and read it in the original.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Saltanatning «mingboshi...» deya qichqirishi bilan barobar aravani to‘xtatgan O‘lmasjon ot ustida orqasiga qayrilib — qanday hodisa bo‘lganini anglayolmasdan — tanfiqosh nazarlari bilan qizlarga tikilgan edi.
en: After all, would it be unexpected for the tsar to know all the languages of the people he ruled? Mullah Rivojiddin was such an excellent writer!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikki qizning bir-biri bilan quchoqlashib, «aylanay, o‘rgilay» qilishlari hali-beri tugalmaydigan bo‘lgandan keyin yelkasini qoqib, yana oldinga o‘girildi va astagina «cho‘x» deb otini qamchiladi.
en: Just look at how he writes: clear like water, whoever reads it will understand and be enchanted! Why won’t the White tsar understand ?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra, u kichkina bir anhorning kechigidan kecharkan, otini sug‘orishga to‘xtagan vaqtida Zebi bilan birga Saltanat ham sharaq-sharaq gapga tushgan edi. Shaharga kirgandan keyin qizlar o‘z uylariga yaqin joylarda bitta-bitta
en: Soon a letter will come from Petersburg to Tashkent, to the viceroy: “They say I have an unsurpassed official there, follow his example, serve me like he does.” And then, oh and then, you’ll look and the nobles will come to him from Tashkent!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: tusha boshladilar, shu bilan safar oxirida O‘lmasjonning Zebidan boshqa yo‘lchisi qolmadi.
en: The city governor and his chief of police will honor him! Then his enemies will seem no more important than a buzzing mosquito.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘ngillaridagi ajib hislarni bir-biriga bildirmoq uchun hali fursat topolmasdan entikkan bu ikki yosh endi o‘n-o‘n besh minut xoli fursat topganla-rida, ortiqcha talvasaga tushgan yuraklari dastidan nima deyishlarini bilolmay entikardilar...
en: This time he held the newspaper to his breast. He wanted to leap up, his head swirling in these fantasies, and embrace Miryoqub, who was seated across from him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Unisi ham, bunisi ham bir og‘iz gap aytolmadi.
en: He wanted to share with him all his wealth, but stopped himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikki yosh ko‘ngilning shu topda kichkinagina bir tilagi bo‘lsa, ham — bir-ikki mahalla o‘tgach, yetiladigan hovlining yana bir necha mahalla nariga cho‘zilishi, yo bo‘lmasa, keksalar aytgandek, «er tanobi»ning pichagina cho‘zilmay turishi edi.
en: However much you give such a man, it is too little. Miryoqub had new business for his master, but mingboshi, who was swimming in joyous thoughts, couldn’t have devoted anything to matters other than the newspaper.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Holbuki, shaharga, o‘ziga oshna joylarga, o‘z otxonasi bor yerlarga kelganini payqagan va qorni ochqay tushgan ot, oshiq-ma’shuqning ko‘ngil tilaklaridan bexabar, qadamini ildamlatar, «erning tanobi» o‘zidan-o‘zi tortilib borardi...
en: “Master, it looks like you are satisfied, correct?” asked Miryoqub with a little pride, though his words were devoid of any greasy, sly obsequiousness. Fully expressing his joy, mingboshi nodded in agreement.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Arava Zebilar masjidi oldiga yetganda, Razzoq so‘fi bir necha kishi bilan birga, boshqa bir aravada qarshi tomonga o‘tib ketdi. — Otam biror joyga ketayotganga o‘xshaydi, — dedi Zebi quvonganini yashirolmay.
en: “What can I say?” “Well then listen further to what I have to tell you.” “What further?” Mingboshi immediately forgot his joy as a wave of anxiety fell over him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yiroqroq safarga o‘xshaydi. Oq yo‘l bersin!
en: No good message could come after this happy news.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi O‘lmasjon va yumshoqqina kuldi. Shu chog‘da Zebining ko‘nglidan og‘ir bir tog‘ ko‘chgan edi.
en: If it was something good, wouldn’t Miryoqub have told him before the letter?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: VI Saltanatning onasi Zebi to‘g‘risidagi tashvishni uning onasiga astagina eshittirib ketganidan keyin, bir kun o‘tib, Razzoq so‘fi qishloqdan keldi.
en: He must have thought, “I’ll calm him down first and then deliver the bad news.” No, to hell with these thoughts of honor and duty!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U eshiqdan kirar-kirmas, to‘y to‘qqizini xotiniga uzatib:
en: The privileges that came with his title were little when compared with its difficulties.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qizing qani? — deya so‘radi.
en: Heavy weighs the crown!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu shoshilinch savol sho‘rlik onaning bag‘riga ti-kondek botdi.
en: In his question, “What further?” mingboshi hinted at all the fears that ate at him. The fox named Miryoqub sensed the anxiety in those two words.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Rangi darrov olindi...
en: He wasted no time.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nimaga indamaysan, hay, Fitna? Nima bo‘ldi senga?
en: “Today you can celebrate!” he announced and then continued.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi so‘fi.
en: The matter concerned the petitions from those Qumariq peasants, who complained that their lands received no water. Miryoqub told of how, after their last conversation, he had gone there, found everything out, and taken the appropriate steps.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xotinining bu ahvoliga u ham qunt qilgan edi. Qurvonbibi tutilib, zo‘rg‘a-zo‘rg‘a gap epladi:
en: The “appropriate steps,” of course, included a little education of the petitioners as well.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Shu yerda... shu yerda... qizingiz...
en: “Good. You said Yodgor the goat and Umarali the noseless were behind it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uch bo‘lib aytilgan shu ikki og‘iz so‘zda ham besaranjom bir jadallik boridi.
en: Now you’ve learned that for certain. Now tell me what you did about them.” Miryoqub smiled.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Erining biror narsa deyishini kutmasdan, bechora xotin boyagi besaranjomlik bilan qatorasiga uch savolni chizib tashladi: — Nimaydi?
en: “What did I do, you ask?” “Yes, what did you do?” Mingboshi, emphasizing these last words, leaned over to Miryoqub.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nimaga so‘raysiz? Chaqirib beraymi?
en: Miryoqub continued, smiling.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir-bir ketin va shoshilish bilan berilgan bu uch savol bir onaning qalbida yolg‘iz bolasiga qanday zo‘r muhabbat saqlanganini Razzoq so‘fiday bir odamga ham keragicha ko‘rsata olgan edi.
en: “I told your mirobs, ‘Give a little water now and then to the low-lying lands.’” Mingboshi raised his voice, “that was how you taught them a lesson?” “Would I have done that if I hadn’t already taught them a lesson?” said Miryoqub, smiling again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U yasama bo‘lsa hamki kulimsiraganday bo‘ldi.
en: “Then what did you do?” “Have a conscience, master!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qizim bo‘ladi-yu so‘ramaymanmi? Qiziq ekansan...
en: We can afford to give Qumariq some water after your lands have been irrigated.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uyga joy qil, jindak orom olay.
en: There’s more than enough water.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘yga borgan odam uyqudan qoladi...
en: No one will raise a fuss. It was your mirobs who were guilty.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qurvonbibi endi o‘ziga kela boshladi. — Kim to‘y qilibdi?
en: They relied too much on your esteem and became complacent.” “Why?” “Simply because.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Badavlat bir odam. Katta osh tortibdi, lekin!
en: After they watered your lands, they didn’t turn the water toward Qumariq.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hast eshonimizni chaqirgan ekan, hammamiz birga bordik...
en: All that stored water filled the old canals and started to turn the unused lands into swamps.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qiyomat suhbatlar6 bo‘ldi!
en: Those downstream were afraid to direct the water themselves.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lekin onaning ko‘ngli hali ham tinchimagan edi:
en: And your mirobs did nothing.” “If there’s too much water, then fine, let them have it,” said mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Zebini nimaga so‘rab edingiz?
en: “I won’t say anything. But those two still need to be taught a lesson.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi yana. Endi bu safar so‘fining achchig‘i keldi va birdaniga:
en: Why did they complain about me?” “If there’s a lesson to be taught, will we lock them up and beat them?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘z qizimni so‘ray olmaymanmi! — deb baqirdi.
en: Or should we just scold them in front of everyone?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, bo‘pti... bo‘pti..
en: Or …” Mingboshi cut Miryoqub off.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Baqirmay qo‘ya qoling!
en: “Well, do something!” he screamed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi kampir va shoshilganicha uyga kirib ketdi.
en: He lowered his voice and added, no less angrily, “At least bring them here and give them to Mirzabobo!” “We can’t just beat them for submitting one complaint. If they complain to the governor again or, if not that, if they go higher up, it will be bad.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hovlida — hovuz bo‘yida kashtasini tikib o‘tirgan Zebi otasining kelganini payqamagan edi.
en: You know how lawyers are!” Mingboshi had no response. He couldn’t breathe.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat bu so‘nggi baqirish uning qulog‘iga alayna borib yetdi, hatto «o‘z qizimni..» degani juda aniq eshitildi.
en: He couldn’t fathom how these two landowners, who were his subordinates, could just be let off. He started to kick the ground with his fat legs in their huge shoes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundan so‘ng ko‘ngli bezovta bo‘lib, darhol o‘rnidan turdi.
en: Miryoqub again set about calming mingboshi, going over to his side with that smile that was all too familiar and, with a voice which even the worst of enemies would trust, said, “The farmers themselves will give them their lesson!” Seeing that he had mingboshi’s interest, he shared with him what he had been up to in Qumariq. He told him that he met with three broad-shouldered young men from among the poor farmers who were suffering and told them that mingboshi had nothing to do with their dry lands, that Yodgor and Umarali were the guilty ones.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U bu yoqqa chiqqan vaqtida chol-kampir uyda edilar, shuning uchun u astagina so‘richaga borib o‘tirdi va ikki ko‘zi uyning eshigida, bilinmagan bir ko‘ngil qoraligi bilan onasining chiqishini kuta boshladi...
en: When the young men asked how those two were guilty, he led them to a place called Sadaqayrag’och and showed them the vegetation there. Sadaqayrag’och truthfully was one of mingboshi’s lands, but because it was well shaded, the cotton there hadn’t grown much nor had it sprouted seeds.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uyga kirib, eshiklarni berkitdirgandan keyin Razzoq so‘fi so‘z ochdi:
en: All around it were Umarali’s and Yodgor’s lands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Zebi qachon keldi?
en: Because their lands had drunk
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Siz ketgan kuni...
en: up the water directed to that small plot of mingboshi’s, their crops appeared far better than his. He showed them the two landowners’ crops and said, “Now look, whose land is getting the most water?” The young men clenched their fists and raised them menacingly in the direction of those lands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ikki kunga deb ketgan narsa necha kun yurdi, bilasanmi? — Eshonoyim qo‘ymabdilar...
en: Later Miryoqub invited the men to a sit-down, having told them that he had a secret to share with them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Eshonoyim!.. Mendami ixtiyor, eshon oyimdami?
en: Their lips quivering and hearts fluttering in this clandestine atmosphere, Miryoqub made them promise not to share his words with anyone.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘zingiz, axir, «Mayli, eshonoyimning ra’ylariga qarasin», demabmidingiz?
en: He then told them of the complaint that Umarali and Yodgor had submitted against mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — E, ra’ylari qursin, ra’ylari!
en: According to Miryoqub, they wrote that mingboshi had refused water only to them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yosh bolani bir hafta — o‘n kun 6 Eshonlarning zikr majlisi
en: Their lands suffered, while others’ flourished. When the young men heard this, one of them shot up from his seat, raising his fists, and shouted, “I’ll find them and kill them, those greedy bastards !” To win them over once and for all, Miryoqub stood up with the young man and announced, “mingboshi is not opposed to sending his extra water to your lands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: sakdaydimi? Kampir nima deyishni bilolmay qoldi.
en: He just doesn’t want his water to go to those two.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kechagina butun ixtiyorni eshonoyimga berib qo‘yib, bugun eshonoyimning tabarruk ra’ylarini ham so‘kib o‘tirgan bu johil so‘figa nima deb bo‘ladi?
en: He told me it would be better for everyone’s lands to dry up than give any more to them. It doesn’t matter, though, because any water that we send down doesn’t make it to your lands, those two take it all!” These last words were salt in the wounds.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har nima bo‘lganda ham, bolasini ko‘rish o‘z zimmasiga tushgan kampir gap topib javob qilmoqqa majbur edi.
en: The three men said almost in one voice, “Have mingboshi give the water and we’ll deal with them!” Miryoqub called mingboshi’s mirobs before the three and ordered them to release the water.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Shuncha vaqtdan beri uyda o‘tira berib yuragi siqilgandan keyin, yosh narsa, uch-to‘rt kun yayramaydimi?
en: Mingboshi listened to Miryoqub’s recounting of his ruse with all the delight of a child listening to a fairy tale.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zingiz ko‘chadan kirmaysizku ! — Menday bo‘lganda, yuraversin!
en: He imagined the misfortunes that were about to fall on the heads of those two landowners in the coming days.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb baqirdi so‘fi. Kampir ham bo‘sh kelmadi, ovozini ko‘tara turib:
en: He now thought that, like a child who has outgrown its clothes, Miryoqub’s moniker “sly” no longer fit him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sizday bo‘lganda ham xotin kishi biror joyga chiqa oladimi?
en: He would have to find him a new one. One thought up by villagers just wouldn’t suit him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi.
en: It would have to be something like Emir Navoiy or Mavlono Jomiy, or at least Shah Mashrab. Mingboshi lost himself in sweet thoughts about the intrigues planned in Qumariq and the master of intrigues, Miryoqub. As Miryoqub stared at mingboshi’s face, which was intoxicated with an unprecedented pleasure, a plate full of dumplings emerged from the ichkari and was placed in the
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bu ro‘zg‘or o‘lgurga kim qaraydi?
en: middle of the table.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tandur qizitib non yopadimi erkak degan narsa? Yo yosh narsani sil qilib, ajalidan besh kun burun o‘ldirmoqchimisiz?
en: Miryoqub’s eyes moved over to the fat, oily, yogurt-laden dumplings, and then slowly back to mingboshi’s face, which had dropped down to the food.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

en: He suddenly noticed that there was almost no difference between the two: mingboshi’s slovenly, unkempt face was just as greasy as the dumplings.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U chidayolmadi: so‘richadan turib kelib, uy darpardalaridan birining takkinasiga o‘tirdi. Endi uyda o‘tayotgan gaplarning har birini uning quloqlari bitta-bitta ovlab borardi.
en: Mingboshi, without a thought to washing his hands and without any offers to serve his guest, sunk both hands into the plate and began his assault.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ko‘p valaqlamasang-chi, Fitna! Quloq-miyamni yeding-ku!
en: Miryoqub headed over to the canal to run some water over his hands.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Jahlimni chiqarma, ha!!! Erining o‘lgudek badjahl ekanini Qurvonbibi yaxshi bilardi.
en: To have time to eat himself, he had to slow mingboshi’s monstrous appetite; the shrewd servant stole his attention with a carefully crafted question.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu so‘nggi tanbehni eshitgandan keyin hatto Zebi ham tashqarida o‘tirib, bir tomondan onasining tashvishini torta boshlagan edi.
en: “So, master, how about that wedding of yours?” he said, shaking the water from his hands. Mingboshi, without lifting his head from the plate, with one dumpling in his mouth and another in his hand, hurriedly answered, “You know best!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kampir birdaniga ovozini pastladi va mumkin qadar o‘zini bosib turib, so‘radi: — Xo‘p, mana, shovqin solmayin.
en: How would I know?” Miryoqub immediately understood that mingboshi could have no thoughts other than his stomach now.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siz ham yotig‘i bilan gapirib bering: nimaga tashqaridan kirar-kirmas, Zebini so‘radingiz?
