license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yosh yigit otining qorinbog‘isini mahkamroq bog‘lash ba-honasi ila aravani devor yoniga to‘xtatar, qo‘li ot tegrasida aylangan holda butun vujudi devor oshib o‘tayotgan qadrdon va yoqimli unni ovlashga tirishardi.
en: What did he say?” The murid outside heard Razzoq-sufi’s voice and answered. “It’s me, Razzoq, me.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir kun qamchisi belida bo‘lgani holda, devor osha qo‘ringan toldan xipchin sindirmoqchi bo‘lib, arava ustiga chiqdi, unda ham bo‘yi yetmagach, tinch turmagan kegaylarga oyoq qo‘yib, g‘ildirakka tirmashdi...
en: Xudoynazar!” Once he realized who it was, Razzoq-sufi didn’t bother to ask why he had come. “Wait, I’m coming.” He quickly went towards the pool and began his ablutions.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir qo‘li bilan devorga osilib, yana bir qo‘lini tolga uzatgan vaqtida ko‘z uchi Zebiga tushdi: bu vaqtda sayrashdan to‘xtagan u tutqun qushcha butun mehrini kashtaning ilang-bilang kunguralariga qo‘ygan edi.
en: By the time Qurvonbibi returned from her neighbor’s, her husband had already left, and Zebi had cleaned up the house. Zebi was singing a song about how a young man had climbed over the wall of a house for a red apple.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘tgan-ketganlar gumonsiramasin, deb, yigitcha, ko‘z uchi hamon hovuz bo‘yida bo‘lgani holda, bir qo‘li bilan kichkina bir tol novdasini sindirishga urinardi.
en: “Hey, Zebi, where is your father?” “His eshon sent for him.” Zebi answered briskly so as not to interrupt the song, which she immediately began again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nihoyat, kichkina novda qirs etib singach, Zebi ham boshini ko‘tarib qaradi, devorda erkak kishining qo‘lini ko‘rganidan keyin:
en: But her mother was very interested in what had hap- pened because her father had been holed up for more than a week without leaving.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Voy, o‘la qolay! Erkak kishi!
en: “God give long life to our eshon!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb qichqirdi...
en: What a nice thing he did!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Va ov yegan qushday, kashtasini tashlab, ichkari tomonga qochdi. Bu xil natijani sira
en: If a man lies in the house for that long, he starts to smell.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: kutmagan yosh yigit, gavroni qo‘lida, hayron bo‘lib qoldi.
en: …” “The mats really have become rank,” joined Zebi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat o‘sha topda ko‘chadan o‘tayotgan bir taqvodorning: — Hoy, bola, tush bu yoqqa!
en: “Take them out and lay them in the sun.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — degan sovuq ovozi uni sarosimalikdan uyg‘otib yubordi... G‘ildirak ustidan o‘zini aravaga tashlagan vaqtida taqvodor yo‘lovchi hali ham so‘ylanmoqda edi:
en: Or take them to the courtyard and beat them,” said Qurvonbibi, counting the smooth coins she received for the mats in her hand.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qanday behayo bolasan!
en: “What a good thing, my dear child.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kap-katta to‘ng‘izday bo‘lib qolibsanu, sharmu hayo qilmasdan, nomahram bor hovliga qaraysan-a!
en: If the eshon can’t lift your father’s lazy body, then who can?” After a brief silence, she brought up her old grief with her husband.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘fi ko‘rgunday bo‘lsa, «go‘sht ketti!» qiladi. Ha!!!
en: “Oh God, to not see his frowning brows again.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yosh yigit ikki beti qip-qizargan holda eshitilar-eshitilmas bir ovoz bilan zo‘rg‘a-zo‘rg‘a:
en: … My heart is filled with woe. It snows from his cold brow, his appearance is that of winter, like an icy blizzard.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Otimga gavron sindiray, degan edim-da... — deya oldi.
en: … If I could just have someone to talk to, to consult with.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra noumid qarash bilan yana bir marta devor tomonga ko‘z yugurtirgach, arava ustidan otga hatlab, yo‘liga ketdi.
en: … If only he could, like other faithful Muslims, have a profession that brought home a few coins a day.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘nggi xabar bilan yuragi siqilganini bahona qilib, bir kun Zebi ham Saltanatxonlarnikiga yo‘l oldi.
en: … No, no! He goes to parties and weddings, fills his stomach, but doesn’t have any other duties.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi oldida o‘zini aybdor sanagan va shuning uchun ko‘nglidan xijolat tortgan Saltanat o‘rtog‘ini ortiq darajada zo‘r hurmat bilan qarshi oldi.
en: He never thinks, ‘I have a wife, I have a daughter, what do they eat?’ He got used to that free soup at the lodge, and now he’ll never agree to work, to sweat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning o‘z o‘rtog‘iga qilgan muomilalarida hatto «pistoqi ta’-zim» qabilidan bir turli yasamalik asarlari ham ko‘rilardi.
en: How his brother tried: ‘Come to the village, we can work together!’ But no! Does he even have the constitution to work?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qishloqdagi voqealarning tagidan bexabar bo‘lgan Zebi Saltanatning bu qadar mehribonlashganini o‘z ko‘nglida boshqa narsaga yo‘yar va... chin ko‘ngildan xursand bo‘lardi.
en: Even if hungry, he wouldn’t lift a finger to do something about it. And every year he scares us with a trip to Mecca!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nima uchun xursand bo‘lardi bu yosh qiz?
en: He has no money to his name, but every year he gets a passport.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U bilardikim, O‘lmasjon Saltanatlar oilasining yon qo‘shnisigina emas, balki ona tomonidan bir qadar qarindoshi va bu xonadonning eng qadrdon bolasi.
en: Like someone who really plans on going he spends all his money on flour and oil, bakes bread. Once the preparations are done, he forgets about the trip, and those moocher murids in the lodge eat the bread for free!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra Zebilar oilasi singari bu oilada ham erkak bola yo‘q, shu uchun qo‘shni va qarindosh bo‘lgan bu bola hamma vaqt shu hovlida, u hovlidan ko‘ra ko‘proq bu hovlining dastyori va yugurdagi.
en: My patience is at an end with it!” Zebi, having brought the mats to the courtyard, listened to her mother’s complaints, astounded at the woman’s mountain-like fortitude.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U bola endi kap-katta yigit bo‘lib qolgan... hozir uylantirish to‘g‘risida ayni og‘iz soladigan vaqtlari... Saltanat o‘zining bu sevimli qarindoshiga bu sevimli o‘rtog‘ini olib bermoq istamaydimi?
en: She decided there and then that she would endeavor to help her mother in whatever way she could so that she didn’t have to bear the burden alone.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Saltanatda bu istak bo‘lgandan keyin, uni onasi bilan katta onasi bilmay qoladimi? Onasi bilan katta onasi Zebini yomon ko‘radilarmi?
en: Did she not know that Qurvonbibi’s mats weren’t the only thing providing their income, but also her own embroidered belts and caps?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yomon ko‘rsalar, o‘z qizlarini unga muncha jonajon o‘rtoq qildirib qo‘yarmidilar?
en: “This is our fate, Mother, what else can we do?” Zebi tried to calm her mother.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi Saltanatdan ko‘rgan ixloslarni uning onasidan va katta onasidan ko‘rmaganmi?
en: The two started to beat the dust from the mats.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ayniqsa, shu safar? Bu safar Saltanat uning tegrasida gir-gir aylangan bo‘lsa, u ikki keksa xotin o‘z
en: “Of course, my child, nothing can be done about fate.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: yoshlariga yarasha pirpirashgan emasmi? Zebiday bir qizning kelin bo‘lib kelishini kim istamaydi?
en: But sometimes the heart can only endure so much and needs to pour everything out.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qaysi hovli Zebini o‘z quchog‘iga olishdan tortinadi? Uchta xotin ustiga mingboshi ham talab bo‘libdi-ku!..
en: …” They both went silent and continued working.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bechora qizning butun bu shirin xayollari shu birgina «mingboshi» so‘zi kelib chiqishi bilan bir varaqasiga parishon bo‘lib sochiladi, to‘kilgan tariq kabi, har tomonga tirqirab ketadi.
en: After a moment the old woman asked, “Why did his eshon call him? The person who came didn’t say anything?” “I don’t know, it sounded urgent.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Haligi shirin xayollar bilan kulib, to‘lib, cho‘g‘day qizarib turgan yuzlari, garmsel tekkan ekin kabi, bir nafasda so‘lib, o‘lib, uchug‘dek bo‘zarib qoladi...
en: He said, ‘Bring him here quickly.’ Father did his ablutions in a hurry and left.” “Good. There’s probably a wedding somewhere.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har qalay, sevimli o‘rtog‘idan va uning onalaridan ko‘rgan ixlos va hurmatlari uchun haligi mulohaza orqasida Zebi xursand, uning xursandligini ko‘rib, o‘z gunohlarining kechirilganini yo bo‘lmasa, ancha yengillashganini o‘ylagan Salti va uning onalari xursand...
en: Your father probably won’t even come back; they’ll go to the village right away. They wouldn’t have called him otherwise.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikkala tomon ham bir-birining ko‘nglidan bexabar, shu xilda xursandlikka ko‘mildi.
en: …” “All the better if he leaves for the village!” said Zebi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining bu xursandligi, albatta, kuzatgan maqsadiga erishmoq bilangina poyidor bo‘lardi.
en: A joyful smile spread across her face at that moment. “I’ll call Saltanat over.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U maqsad ham, dovon oshuv qadar zo‘r bo‘lmasdan, nihoyati de-vorga osilib, gavron sindirgan yigitni bir ko‘rishdan iborat edi...
en: If she comes, we’ll have a great time.” “Very well. If your father doesn’t come home tonight, you’ll call her tomorrow .” The girl’s smile, having spread out like a drop of water in the sand, suddenly disappeared.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat chorbozorchi bilan aravakashni uyida uchratmoq oson narsami?
en: Dark clouds of worry gathered over her now serious eyes. “We have neither flour nor rice.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘lmasjonning ara-vakashlikka kirishganiga faqat to‘rt oy bo‘ldi, lekin shu to‘rt oy ichida to‘rt marta butun kechakunduzni  uyida o‘tkaza oldimi?
en: Are we really going to treat guests to stale bread again?” asked Zebi. And without waiting for an answer, she added, “Will there ever be salvation from poverty?” “Don’t worry, my child, we won’t send your friend away hungry.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sahar chiqib ketadi, yarim kechada kirib keladi, agar olisga ketmasa!
en: We will figure something out.” Zebi looked at her mother with eyes wide open. “Truly?” Qurvonbibi took the coins from the knot in her handkerchief and handed them to her daughter and said with all the happiness of a hunter having hit his target, “Here, my child, the money from my mats has found a use!” Zebi threw her arms around her mother’s neck; after her mother stroked her softly a few times, she nuzzled her face into Zebi’s hair.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Olisga ketsa, ikki-uch kun o‘tkazib keladi.
en: The two worn and pained hearts allowed themselves a little joy. ...
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bolasining darbadarligiga achingan ona o‘sha kuni — Zebi Saltanatlarnikiga borgan kuni:
en: The joy in those four walls was as momentary as a passerby’s glance.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Hunar bo‘lmay o‘lsin! — deya so‘zlandi.
en: So quick that if you saw its appearance you might not even note its departure.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bolam bechoraning yuzini kun yorug‘ida ko‘rolmayman! Ishlab-ishlab topgani nima?
en: Why don’t the poor women who grow up inside four walls, who don’t see anything other than the sharp looks of those permitted inside, sense the tragedy of their sheltered lives?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Topib keltirgani nima?
en: If they are so used to seeking little joys inside their four walls, can these poor things ever believe that the shameful joys which wander in from outside are part of something greater? Zebi usually went to sleep not long after the evening prayer and woke with the morning prayer, but that night she stayed up talking with her mother to see whether her father would return.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ro‘zg‘orga yuq bo‘lmaydi... Qaymog‘ini karvonboshi yalaydi, albatta.
en: Talking about whatever came to mind, the two went through three pots of tea.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu sho‘rliklar yugurgani-yugurgan, qatnagani-qatnagan, karvonboshi — og‘zining yeli bilan topadi... Shu ham insofmi?
en: When the whole country had gone to sleep, there was still no word from Razzoq-sufi, so mother and daughter decided that he must have gone somewhere with his eshon.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bunga otaning g‘ashi keldi: — Muncha jovraysan, hay!
en: Zebi went to her bed with the sweet dreams of her friend’s visit.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi. — Shukur qilsang-chi!
en: She woke up much later than usual the next day because of especially satisfying dreams.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qimorboz bo‘lib, bor-yo‘g‘ingni «gardkam»ga bersa, nima qilarding?
en: When she opened her eyes, she immediately saw that the outside door was wide open.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ahmadalining katta o‘g‘liday butun ro‘zg‘orini ichkilikka sovursa, nima qilarding?
en: Her father had returned. She was surprised she had slept so soundly: her father usually made such a clatter when at the door.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ishga kirganiga to‘rt oy endi bo‘ldi. Haligacha oz topgan bo‘lsa, bundan nari ko‘p topar.
en: In the time between hearing someone answer his call and the door opening, the ill-tempered Razzoq-sufi often took his walking stick to the door, beating it with all his might.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hali yosh, ishlasin ozroq... Mehnatsiz rohat bormi, qalay!
en: Zebi must have slept like a corpse to not have heard that racket.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ishga kirganiga to‘rt oy bo‘ldi-yu, to‘rt yillik charchadi bolam!
en: Now any attempt to invite Saltanat over had gone to the winds.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: dedi ona. — To‘rt yillik qaridi bolam!
en: Razzoq-sufi’s head wouldn’t rise from his pillow for another few weeks.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bola tug‘ish, katta qilish osonmi? Ko‘cha-ko‘yda yurib, gapira berasizlar-da!
en: Now the young girl, in the very bloom of her life, would spend God knows how long by the pool, needle in hand.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «To‘rt oy endi bo‘ldi-ya!..» Og‘zingizning bir chekasidan chiqadi!..
en: She got up, washed her face and hands, lit the fire in the hearth, and put the pot on.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘q, aravakashligi qursin!
en: Then she closed the outside door and went inside the house.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Boshqa ishga beramiz... bo‘lmadi bu.
en: The house was dark inside since both windows were covered.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Boshini yesin karvoning!.. — Boshqa ish oson, deysanmi?
en: She silently began to listen: she distinctly heard sobbing.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb e’tiroz qildi ota.
en: She kept listening. It was her mother.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Dunyoda oson ish bormi?
en: Her heart skipped a beat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Puling bo‘lsa, davlating bo‘lsa, og‘zing bilan gapirib topsang... qani edi...
en: Then she heard her father’s muttering. “God gave women tears.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu davlatni xudovandi karim hammaga bermas ekan!
en: So cry!” Everything inside the house went quiet.

As the Uzbek saying goes, “The itty-bitty one takes down the great khan.” When the caravan of in-laws left for the city, Poshshaxon drove off Umrinisabibi, who had surreptitiously climbed onto the cart, telling her, “If I see you at the wedding or after, I’ll have mingboshi throw you in a dungeon!” But she either didn’t see or simply paid no heed to the woman’s daughter in the cart.

license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U hali ham lablarini tishlardi...
en: Or by whom?” “I don’t know.” “Think harder.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tong otib, uy ichi yorishganda, xotin o‘rnidan turdi va darrov choyshabini yopinib, orqasiga qayrildi-da, usti ochilib yotgan erkakka ko‘z tashladi: tarvuz singari yum-yumaloq, semiz qorni solinib tushgan, ikki beti sergo‘sht — bo‘rtma, kichkina va ma’nosiz ko‘zlarga ega bir maxluq!
en: Who could it be that disgusts you?” “Someone, but I don’t know who.” “If you don’t know, let’s help you. Look at me, by whom are you disgusted?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Pishillab nafas oladi, xurrak tortib uxlaydi!
en: Is it not Miryoqub? Why are you silent?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ana, u ham uyg‘ondi, joyidan turmasdan, boshini bir oz ko‘tardi.
en: Am I right? Is it Miryoqub?” “You’re right.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kuldi. Buncha xunuk kuladi!
en: I’m disgusted by Miryoqub.” “And you should be!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ikkita tilla tishi o‘chayotgan cho‘qqa o‘xshaydi.
en: As high as that Miryoqub might soar, he’ll never rise above himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Juda siyrak bo‘lgan sochlari chala o‘rilgan ekinzor kabi...
en: Because he is a dog! A vile, low, and pitiful dog!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Nechuk men butun bir kechani shu bilan o‘tkaza oldim?..» dedi xotin 10 Bosma ayilli shim – tasmali (podtyajkali) shim.
en: Sure, sometimes he paints himself as a lion or a snow leopard or even a man. But like a raven that flies with pigeons gives itself away with its first caw, so the lustful dog in you barks in a crowd.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: o‘z-o‘ziga, yana lablarini tishladi.
en: Everyone sees right through your human features .
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Beriroq kel-chi! — dedi erkak.
en: Miryoqub despises Akbarali mingboshi, he curses him, he mocks his mongrel lust.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xotin qon chiqar darajada shiddat bilan lablarini tishlagani holda, o‘ylab o‘tirmasdan, qo‘mondaga itoat qilgan soldatday, kartga yaqin bordi.
en: Miryoqub feels no shame, he doesn’t bury his head in the ground from embarrassment. But the ground refuses, disdains to take his head in its mahram breast!” “I only prepared myself to answer questions here.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Egil bir oz! Xotin egildi.
en: Now I see that the interrogator wants to accuse me of crimes!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Chakki emas!
en: What is it that I did?!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi erkak, xursand bo‘lib kuldi.
en: Whom did I tell what?” “Silence, Miryoqub!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra qo‘li bilan deraza tokchasiga ishorat qilib: — Ana, chek!
en: We will ask the questions as we see fit and accuse you where needed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi. Yana boshini yostiqqa qo‘ydi.
en: You just wait, Miryoqub!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xotin tezgina chekni olib, xayrlashmasdanoq uydan chiqdi.
en: You’ll have a chance to defend yourself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘z uyiga kelganidan so‘ng darhol oynaga qaradi, o‘z aftidan qo‘rqib ketdimi, bilmadim — o‘zini kartga tashlab, ho‘ngur-ho‘ngur yig‘lashga tushdi...
en: You’ll have your word. Be patient!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uch yuz so‘mlik chek qo‘lidan tushib, allaqaylarda to‘ntarilib yotardi...
en: Be patient! Just wait your turn!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun Miryoqubga boshqa «xaridorlar» kabi qarayolmasligini bu yosh xotin o‘zi ham bildi.
en: Everything in its time!” “I have the right to refuse answers to such an interrogator!” “What did you say, valiant Miryoqub?!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Bu, hech bo‘lmasa, olgan molini qadrlay oladigan savdogar mu-omilasini qildi-ku, — deb o‘yladi u. — Xotin kishiga nozik tarbiyali bir frantsuz kabi yaqinlasha bildi-qu!
en: Do you have objections, reservations about the interrogator? For what reason?” “Many can’t tell a horse from a mule.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Koshki hamma xaridor shunday bo‘lsa!» Bu xotin o‘zicha haqli, albatta.
en: So what? After all, they look similar to one another.” “Well, well?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qullarini urmasdan yaxshi gapirib ishlatadigan, urganlar kunda o‘n besh soat ishlatsa, yaxshi gapirib kunda yigirma soat ishlatadigan xo‘jalar ham bo‘ladi-ku... — O‘tir!
en: Speak then!” “But those that can’t tell a mule from a horse have no business conducting interrogations and leveling accusations.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi Miryoqub sensirab. Fonarni yana yoqdi.
en: They have no right!” “Well, Miryoqub, speak!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Stolning past tomoniga o‘zi o‘tirib, to‘r tomonidan unga joy ko‘rsatdi.
en: We like this kind of talk.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘tirdilar. Xotin o‘z «vazifa»sini yaxshi bilganligidan, shu topda gap emas, «ish» kutardi va bu tahqirlanishning sababini anglayolmasdi...
en: What do you want to say?” “I strongly object to your equation of me, in whatever form you might put it, with Akbarali mingboshi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Har qanday orginal tip bo‘lsa ham, maqsadi belgili.
en: This is an insult, not a question!” “Calm yourself, my friend.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu joyda o‘zga maqsad bo‘lishi mumkin emas!» deb o‘ylardi u. Miryoqub bo‘lsa, nima deyishga hayron bo‘lib, boshi qotib o‘tirardi.
en: We believe there is as much difference between Miryoqub and Akbarali mingboshi as between earth and sky, of course!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu odam xalq orasida zakonchi hisoblangani bilan rus tilini maqsad anglatarlik bilmaydi.
en: Akbarali is one person, and Miryoqub is another.” “Then I am satisfied with your answer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qarshisida — Osiyo bilan yaqinda tanishgan bir nozik rus xotin, Osiyo bilan yaxshi tanishganda ham sart tilini o‘rganishga tanaffur qiladimi?
en: Continue with the next question!” “Whether you are satisfied, that’s your business.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zohirda bu narsaga dalolat qiladigan hech bir asar yo‘q! «Bu xotin, men bilan frantsuzcha gaplashsa gaplashadiki, sartcha bir so‘z ham bilmaydi», dedi o‘z-o‘ziga Miryoqub...
en: But we are not yet satisfied.” “Meaning?” “We consider Akbarali mingboshi more of a man than Miryoqub.” “What, what?!” Miryoqub’s words caught in his throat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Holbuki, aytadigan ancha so‘zlar, so‘raydigan ancha gaplari bor.
en: “Unfortunate, but it is so.” “Why is that? Why?” Miryoqub roared like a lion.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu
en: “Miryoqub!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: xotinga boshqa shu xil xotinlarga qaragan singari qarayolmasligiga uning o‘zi ham ishonib qolgan.
en: In whose bosom did you spend last night?” Miryoqub was startled.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Boshida boshqacha planlar aylanadi...
en: He turned red. He wanted to run away.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nihoyat, shirin maydan bir qadahchaga to‘ldirib, uning oldiga qo‘ydi.
en: He wanted to run away from himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zi yarim qadah aroq quydi. — Ich!
en: No, a person cannot escape himself!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi Miryoqub yana sensirashida davom etib.
en: “Speak, Miryoqub! We have that copy of your soul right in front of us.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Birinchi marta sensiraganida, negadir qunt qilmagan xotin bu safar hayrat aralash ranjib qo‘ydi.
en: … Speak, confess now and it will be good for you.” “I spent last night in noyib to’ra’s home.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Bu osiyoli ham «sen» bilan boshladi», dedi o‘z-o‘ziga.
en: His cook Zunnun invited me to a party.” “Is that it?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Cho‘qishtirib ichdilar.
en: Nothing else?” “That’s it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub endi bir ish qilib maqsadini anglatishga bel bog‘ladi.
en: When I left in the morning, I was told there were wounded soldiers coming in from the mountains.” “Thank you, Miryoqub! We hadn’t heard about that.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ruschaga sira o‘xshamagan bir til bilan, ko‘proq qo‘llariga va yuz-qo‘zlarga zo‘r berib, maqsadini anglatishga kirishdi.
en: Thank you, but tell us now: in whose bosom did you spend last night?” “I’m not sure what happened. At dawn, I opened my eyes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xotin qotib-qotib kular, yuzlari cho‘gday yonib qizarar, Miryoqubning qistovi bilan shirin maydan bir oz-bir oz ho‘plab qo‘yib, so‘z tinglardi.
en: I was in bed, and standing nearby was noyib to’ra’s wife. We drank a lot the previous night, I don’t know what happened.”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘zlar boshda Miryoqubning g‘alati savollaridan iborat bo‘ldi:
en: “You wanted to say that this was not a willful act; that you didn’t want it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qachon jo‘naysan? — dedi u. Bu birinchi aytilgan so‘z edi.
en: Is that correct?” “Yes!” “So policemen, swords drawn, surrounded you and forced you into her arms?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xotin anglamadi. Boshini chayqadi.
en: You poor thing, Miryoqub!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra Miryoqub qo‘l ishoratlari bilan birga haligi so‘zni yana takror qildi.
en: You’ve suffered so much. You were in a dungeon, a prisoner of others’ desires!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qaerga? — dedi xotin.
en: Is that right?” “No!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Men bilmayman. O‘zing bilasan.
en: I came to her myself, on my own feet.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu narsa xotinni butunlay gangratib qo‘ydi. «Nima demokchi bu sevimli aziat?» Miryoqub maqsadini anglatolmasdan, savolni boshqacha qilib berdi:
en: I consciously threw myself into her embrace!” “And did you pay for the alcohol?” “I did!” “And who told the woman that you would continue to see each other?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bir yarim mingga yetdimi? Yo hali ham sakkiz yuzmi?
en: Do you not know?” “It was me.” “And who was overjoyed when she responded, ‘with pleasure’?” “Me.” “Miryoqub!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xotin tushundi, u shoshib qoldi. «Nimalar deydi bu g‘alati aziat?
en: Any just person would call what you did adultery: you violated another man’s wife!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Menga bir yarim ming so‘m pul kerakligini, hozir faqat sakkiz yuz so‘m yig‘ilganini qaydan biladi?
en: Has Akbarali mingboshi ever done such a thing in his whole life? Do you not know?” “He probably hasn’t.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Muammo, muammo!..» Bora-bora kerakli so‘zlar osonroq topiladigan, boshqacharoq so‘zlar bilan aytilgan mavhumlar ham ikki tomonga anglashiladigan, qo‘l va yuzko ‘z harakatlari ko‘zga tanish ko‘rinadigan bo‘lib qoldi.
en: I don’t know.” “Very good! Who is Akbarali mingboshi to you?” “A father.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xotinning yoqimli jaranglab chiqadigan quvnoq ovozi Miryoqubning tanlariga igna botganday botar, lekin nihoyat darajada kayfini keltirardi.
en: My patron.” “And you accumulated a lot of wealth behind his back? We have a copy of your soul in our hands, speak!” “I did.” “Good.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub nomer xo‘jayinining uyida bergan qarorini mustahkamladi, ya’ni bu juvonni o‘zi bilan birga, bir-ikki oy o‘ynatib, kelish uchun Qrimga olib ketadigan bo‘ldi.
en: Have you heard of Poshshaxon?” “I don’t know. No!” “Think harder.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qrimdan so‘ng qo‘liga ikki ming so‘m pul beradi va mumkin bo‘lsa, Petrogradgacha olib borib qo‘yadi.
en: You know her well!” “Yes, I know her!” “Who is she?” “Akbarali mingboshi’s, if I’m not mistaken, second wife.” “Correct.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Undan nari bu xotin haligi pulning kuchi bilan Germaniyaga (dushman mamlakatiga!) qochadi
en: Now tell us: she was another man’s wife; her husband, by your own admission, is your father, your patron.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: va unda badavlat akasiga qovushadi.
en: Why did you corrupt her?” “You’re slandering me!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu sirlarni u Miryoqubga «ko‘nglining yaqinligidan» aytdi va — «sirlarning ochilishi uning halokatiga sabab bo‘lishini» ham qayd qilib o‘tdi.
en: I didn’t corrupt her!” “No need to get excited. We’re listening.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub deraza tokchasidan eski bir kulgili jurnalni olib, undan tuya suratini topdi va «Tuya ko‘rdingmi?
en: Why did you corrupt her? Do you deny having an affair with her?” “I don’t deny it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘q!» degan chuchmal maqolni anglatmoqchi bo‘ldi shekilli:
en: If anything, it was she who corrupted me.” “Why?” “If you’ll allow it, I’ll tell you what happened.”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ko‘rdingmi? Yo‘q!
en: “We need to know the truth.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — dedi xotinga. Bu so‘z ruschada «Videl?
en: Tell us!” Miryoqub cleared his throat and began his story.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Net?» shaklida chiqqanligidan xotin: — Ko‘rganman (videla)!
en: Just like mingboshi’s other wives, she kept good relations with my family.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb javob berdi. Xotin uning jon kuydirib gapirgan gapini anglamagan edi.
en: As we sarts tend to, we visited each other and had dinner together frequently.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub qizidi, barmog‘i bilan tuya suratini bir necha marta turtib, yana o‘sha savolni takrorladi. Xotin bu daf’a:
en: About, maybe, four or five months ago, it must have been spring, my wife tells me, “mingboshi’s second wife Poshshaxon is such a nice woman!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, ha, ko‘rib turibman (viju), ko‘rib turibman!
en: She is so kind to us, there are simply no words.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — deb javob berdi.
en: She’s always bringing food and keeping me company.

en: I kissed the edge of my mat. She must have thought that I was leaving them for good since I didn’t even kiss the children.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shunga ishonib, uncha-muncha erkalik qilamiz-da.
en: She started crying again. The poor woman didn’t know that I didn’t kiss them because I love them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uncha-muncha...
en: maryam.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Tog‘day-tog‘day gunohlar ham uncha-muncha bo‘lar ekan-da!
en: (the name Miryoqub gave Maria, though wasn’t Yevdokiya her name?)
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub xoxolab kuldi:
en: Oh God! Oh my God!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Tog‘day-tog‘dayini endi sizdan o‘rganamiz, to‘ra, xudo xohlasa...
en: What is this? Am I dreaming or am I awake?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siz, axir, mulla odamsiz...
en: Where am I? What am I doing?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘ra ham «qah-qah» solib kuldi.
en: What was yesterday? What is today?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shngra devordagi soatga qaradi: 8 dan 15 minut o‘tgan edi.
en: What will tomorrow be? Jakob opened the door to my room, let me in, and left.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘rnidan turdi.
en: I locked the door behind him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sen o‘tirib tur, men kiyinib olay. Birgalashib chiqamiz.
en: I sentenced myself, believing his word alone, to five days in that prison.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘ra kiyinib chiqqandan keyin Miryoqub ham o‘rnidan turdi. — Qani, yur buyoqqa.
en: I expected to go out only five times during those five days and only when everyone was asleep.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Boqcha tomondan chiqaylik. Xonim kelmagan, kampir uxlab qolibdi.
en: The rest of the time I would spend in that little, sweet, safe room.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Eshikni berkitib oladigan kishi yo‘q.
en: Anything could happen during those five days!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ayvonga chiqdilar. Sahnga tushgach, to‘ra to‘xtadi.
en: I had my doubts: ‘What if he doesn’t come?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Miryoqub, yangi gapdan xabaring bormi?
en: What if he gets sick of me? Maybe after a month, a year?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yo‘q, to‘ra. — Tog‘ tomondan olomon qo‘zg‘alon ko‘tarib, bir-ikkita amaldornikiga o‘t qo‘yibdi.
en: Maybe he’ll come back soon, but will he have changed towards me and be just another ordinary client?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ertaga tushdan keyin, yonimga askar olib, chiqib ketayotirman.
en: Maybe then he’ll come for just an hour or half an hour … What will I do then?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bugun ham o‘n yetti kishini ushlab keltirdilar.
en: Will I go back to that disgusting place? No!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Olomon quturgan, deydi.
en: No! It would be better to die.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qachon kelasiz?
en: So much better.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ikki-uch kun qolsam kerak.
en: Why did I trust him?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sen Akbaraliga ayt, tezroq joyiga borsin.
en: Why?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Xo‘p, jonim bilan. Biz ham ertaga chiqib borarmiz.
en: Why did I trade all my hopes and desires for the word of some stranger?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Hozir har bir mingboshiga yana yettidan yigit berish masalasini ko‘tardik, ehtimol yaqinda ruxsat bo‘lib qolsa.
en: What kind of stupid woman am I? Have I ascended a mountain just to fall painfully into that same swamp?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Yaxshi bo‘lardi. Bularning ovozini eshitib, oshxona tomondan to‘raning oshpazi Zunnun keldi.
en: When you live in the swamp you get used to the air.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub bilan ko‘rishdi. — Miryoqub aka, chiqib ketayotirsizmi?
en: But once you’re out, breathing that fresh mountain air, can you really dive back in?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Biznikiga bir kirib chiqing.
en: I must be crazy!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bitta choy damlab beray.
en: Crazy!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Sizga bir gapim boridi... Miryoqub to‘raga qaradi.
en: He’s a rich merchant, I knew that.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Juda yaxshi! Bir oz choy ichib, gaplashib borarsan.
en: Why didn’t I tell him, ‘Give me a check for 1, rubles, then I’ll believe you’?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zunnunboy zerikkandir.
en: He would’ve given it to me.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: To‘ra kumush boshli hassasini yerga ura-ura panjara eshiqdan chiqib ketdi. Bular oshxona tomonga burildilar.
en: Then it would be his problem: he could come or he could not come.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: * * * Zunnun akaning uyi oshxona bilan don omborining o‘rtasida edi.
en: I would have been on my way. … Towards my goal.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu bir qavatli, tor derazali, xom gashtdan yopilgan bostirmalar esa, sahnning to‘g‘risida, noyib to‘raning o‘z uylari o‘rnashgan pishiq g‘ishtli yaxshi binoning qarshisida bo‘linardi.
en: … And if he didn’t give me the check, I would have known that he didn’t love me and I wouldn’t have trusted him. … I would have saved myself the worry.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu bostirmalarning keti boqcha va gulzor.
en: I’m stupid! I didn’t notice that two days had passed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Oshxonaning derazasi sahnga — oldinga qaragani holda, Zunnun aka turadigan uyning faqat boqcha tomondan bir kichkina deraza va eshigi boridi.
en: The thoughts and doubts gave me no peace. I thought and I thought; I didn’t know whether to laugh or to sob!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U uyga oshxona orqali o‘tsa ham bo‘lardi.
en: I started to hear careful steps behind the door.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Oshxonadan ham sahn, ham boqcha tomonga eshik ochilardi. Zunnun akaning uyiga kirmasdan, gulzorda bir skameykaga o‘tirdilar.
en: It must be some scoundrels who have heard that a young beautiful girl is all alone in her room, I thought.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub tezroq borib o‘zining yangi yulduzini yana bir ko‘rmoqchi va o‘z boshiga yolg‘iz qoldi-rilgan mingboshidan ham xabar olmoqchi edi.
en: Even the servant who brought the food asked why I didn’t go outside. “Did someone ask about me?” I said.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi boladay narsa... uni ko‘p ham yolg‘iz qoldirib bo‘lmaydi.
en: “No,” he answered, “should someone have?” “My husband,” I replied.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu uchun Miryoqub choy qo‘ymoq uchun turayotgan oshpazni to‘xtatdi:
en: He was silent. After that I didn’t hear any steps outside the door.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Zunnun, men shoshilib turibman.
en: Am I dreaming or am I awake?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Gapingni ayt. Tezroq bormasam bo‘lmaydi.
en: I remember hearing a soft knocking on the door.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqubning ovozida allaqanday besaranjomlik ham yo‘q emasidi.
en: Only two nights had passed since we’d parted. He said he’d be back on the fifth day.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Buni Zunnun payqadi. — Nima bo‘ldi sizga, Miryoqub aka!
en: The knocking sounded like the servant’s.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ovozingizda bir bezovtalik bor... — Hech narsa bo‘lgani yo‘q, shoshilib turibman.
en: It must be the servant, I thought, opening the door without checking.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Unday demang.
en: And he came in!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bari bir, men bilaman.
en: Oh, that Asian!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bizning to‘ra ham juda xafa. Xonim bo‘lsalar tez-tez «Rusiyaga ko‘chib ketsakmikan?» deb qo‘yadi.
en: We didn’t greet each other, he didn’t extend his hand to me, and I didn’t offer mine either.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Sen ham ketasanmi?» deb so‘raydi.
en: He didn’t say a word.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ular dunyoning hamma holu ahvolini bilib turadigan odamlar, bir narsani sezishgandir-da, men bu yerda har xil o‘ruslar bilan gaplashaman.
en: Like a mute, he came in and just showed me the tickets in his hand. He called in the servant, and we paid the check.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hammasi har narsa deydi.
en: Then we left for the train station.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘ylab ko‘rsangiz, hammasining gapi bor: «Bir balo bo‘ladiganga o‘xshaydi».
en: And now the two of us are in one compartment. Our hearts are one.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub boshini ko‘tardi.
en: Our bodies—separate. The train keeps on moving.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘ruslar shunaqa deydimi?
en: I close my eyes. … Am I dreaming or awake?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qani, gapir, yana nima deyishadi?
en: jakob. It looks like we passed Tashkent last night.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Aytdim-qu, hamma har xil gapiradi.
en: Now we’re headed into the miserable , boring steppe.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Lekin gapning tagi bir joydan borib chiqadi: «Bir balo bo‘ladiganga o‘xshaydi».
en: A man with his hair cut short in a new Tashkent skullcap and a European suit appeared in our car.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nima balo ekan, bizning aqlimiz yetmaydi.
en: He has a short, well-preened mustache. Pale complexion.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Har qalay, bir balosi bor.
en: Not bad looking. A foppish gait.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Miryoqub ahvoldan bu daraja xabardor bo‘lgan odamdan sir yashirishni lozim ko‘rmadi:
en: He looks like a Tashkenter. Maybe a merchant.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Rost aytasan, — dedi.
en: Or a lawyer. Or a bureaucrat.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — To‘ra menga ko‘p gaplarni aytdi. Biribiridan  vahimalik...
en: In any event, he reads Russian, I see Russian newspapers in his hand.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning gaplarini eshitib, men o‘z-o‘zimga «Zamona oxir bo‘pti.
en: He’s passed by our compartment a few times now and looked around the car.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qiyomat yaqin shekilli», dedim...
en: Was he looking at me and Maryam?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Shuning uchun men sizni chaqirib edim.
en: Were his eyes on Maryam ?!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zunnun Miryoqubning yonginasiga o‘tirdi.
en: Those Tashkent merchants are dandies.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Men qirqqa borib qoldim.
en: They like European girls.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Haligacha bitta boshim ikkita bo‘lgani yo‘q.
en: They’re no strangers to corrupting young women.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Keng ko‘rpada yolg‘iz o‘zim qaltirab yotaman...
en: I started to worry and closed the door.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mening ham orzuhavasim  bor.
en: It’s stuffy in the compartment.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uylansam, bola-chaqa ko‘rsam, deyman. — Juda yaxshi.
en: Maryam is starting to worry.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘zingga loyiq bir qiz topiladi, albatta.
en: I’ll have to open the door again. maryam.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qiz tayyor... qishloqda mening bir xolam bor, o‘sha darak solib topgan ekan.
en: Jakob must love me. If he wasn’t in love, he wouldn’t behave like this.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Endi qistab yotibdi.
en: Oh, let it be true!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Uylana ber, nimasi bor? Taraddudingni qila ber, to‘yni birgalashib o‘tkazamiz.
en: A good-looking sart keeps looking in on us.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Men xo‘jayinning olidan bir o‘tib qo‘ysammikan, deb edim.
en: Is he looking at Jakob or me? I don’t know.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — To‘g‘ri, sening otaxoning bo‘lib qoldi.
en: He must be looking at me.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘raganing yaxshi. — Shuni aytaman.
en: Because why would a man be looking at another man?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zunnun kuldi. Miryoqubga tomon yana ham yaqinroq burildi.
en: Although they say that sarts do have a custom of men loving other men.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Shu to‘g‘rida xo‘jayin bilan gaplashib bersangiz, deb edim...
en: Fun! My little Jakob, my beloved Jakob is starting to worry.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘zing-chi?
en: He closed the door.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘zim... betlayolmayman. — Nega?
en: Then I let out a sigh and he opened it.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.
