en: Among them was Poshshaxon, whose arrow had missed its mark.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qo‘y, mayli, ichmasang ichma, — dedi mingboshi. — O‘zim ichaman!
en: Who knows whether she was crying for mingboshi or because of Miryoqub’s treachery or maybe because her women’s bane had been the bane of another.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir shishani tamom qilib, yuvuqsiz qo‘li bilan oshga chang soldi.
en: This crime of womanly jealousy, in a time of revolt, was like fat thrown on the fire.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Oshning yarmi barmoqlari orasidan dasturxonga, ko‘rpa-to‘shakka, o‘zining liboslariga to‘kilardi.
en: The small-minded officials of the small district’s capital suddenly raised this worthless victim of an accident to a hero of their time.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi devorga suyanib bu qo‘rqinch kuyovni tomosha qilardi... Mingboshi, og‘zida to‘la osh bilan: «Netayxon, aylanay, yodimga tushdi-e...» deb xirgoyi qildi.
en: These officials endeavored to boast of their accomplishments before their superiors by lioniz- ing a success of tsarist policy: a tamed and submissive servant, whom they had drawn from the ranks of a “wild” people.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Oshli og‘iz bilan boshlangan xirgoyi tomoqqa tiqildi, ming-boshi qalqib ketdi va og‘zidagi oshni kosaga purkab yana oshga qo‘l uzatdi.
en: If they let their leaders be poisoned (by a woman and her bane no less!), then how could they command authority among the people? Especially among these “wild” people.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining ko‘ngli aynidi, shekilli, sekingina tisarilatisarila  dahlizga chiqdi.
en: What would the ineffectiveness of their power say to those “wildlings”? There could be no political wavering in a colony on the doorstep of British India.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Dahlizda bir piyola sovuq suv ichdi.
en: No, the result would be very bad! Terrifying!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yuragi kuygani bosilmadi, shekilli, yana quymoqchi bo‘ldi. Suv yo‘q edi.
en: Dispatches full of panic and fear flew to Tashkent, and just three days after the event, a delegation of the colony’s military court arrived in the village.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir qanoti ochiq eshikdan uyga qaradi. Mingboshi yana bitta shishani ochib, piyolaga to‘ldirayotgan edi...
en: The investigation was already concluded by the time the court arrived.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi tashqariga chiqib, toza qor bilan qo‘lini yuvdi, toza qorni yuzlariga surkadi, jindak yedi.
en: The
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ancha shamollab va yengillab kirgan vaqtida, mingboshi dasturxon yonida ag‘nab uchib qolgan edi. Uni qo‘zg‘atib o‘tirmasdan, dasturxonni sekingina yig‘ishtirib oldi-da, bir chekkaga bir yostiqni tashladi, ustiga bir to‘shakchani yopindi, fonarni pastladi, shu bilan uyquga yotdi.
en: investigation was so quick, in fact, that the court’s translator quipped: “Why is the speed here and not at the front?!” The translator wasn’t one of those old foxes who prowled around the courts, but, for some reason, one of the new officials summoned from other territories , though he was a Turkestani Muslim.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Orada qancha uxlagandir, o‘zi ham bilmaydi, besaranjon bir qichqiriq bilan uyg‘ondi: — Suv!
en: The officials in the city and locals didn’t know him well.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Suv! — deb qichqirardi mingboshi.
en: After all, he was just a lowly postal worker.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi uyqusirab kelib, yana fonarni balandlatdi.
en: But the lawyer whom the court assigned to be Zebi’s defender … oh, the lawyer was from another world altogether!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ungacha mingboshining qo‘rqinch ovozi yana ko‘tarila tushdi:
en: This man, no, this magnificent individual was from one of the faraway places in Turkestan (maybe just north of Iran?).
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sintaloqdi qizi, suv, deyman! Suv!
en: He had, they said, embezzled quite a bit from the government treasury as a military official.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yuragim kuyib ketdi...
en: If the tsar really respected the laws, he would have had this man shot or exiled somewhere. But just as he always covered his head with an umbrella in this hot, practically uninhabitable country, he had friends in high places to cover his indiscretions.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yonib ketdi!.. Suv!
en: They would never let one of their own burn.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Suv!!! Zebi shoshib qoldi, tez borib choynakdagi tabarruk suvni qo‘liga oldi va — hech narsa o‘ylashga fursat yo‘q — darhol mingboshiga uzatdi...
en: With their help, he lost only his military rank and then exiled himself from colony to colony, finally settling into a career as a lawyer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi choynakdagi suvni bir shimirishda tamom qildi.
en: Of course, he did!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi endi uning tinchib uyquga ketishini kutardi. Yoniga yumshoq bolishlardan ikkitasini qo‘ydi, ustiga kichkinagina bir to‘shakni yopdi.
en: Because is it really difficult for a man who deceived and stole from an entire state to steal from ordinary people?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Mingboshi ham tinchib qolganday bo‘ldi.
en: Experience is its own wealth!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebining kipriklari endi bir-biriga tekkanda, mingboshi birdaniga dahshatli bir tovush chiqardi.
en: But among that experience and wealth, his most valuable assets were his connections!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘rnidan turib kamarlarini, to‘nlarini apiltapil  yechishga boshladi.
en: No self-respecting lawyer could take on the suspect cases that he did and win most of them.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zebi butun bu harakatlarni boyagi singari mastlik asarlari, deb o‘yladi.
en: It was easy for this reborn Plevako to take these ignorant locals for all they were worth.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uning kamar va to‘nlarini bir-bir olib, qoziqqa ildi, ikkalasi uchun solingan joyni tuzatdi — erini sekingina olib bo-rib yotqizmoqchi bo‘lardi... Mingboshining ko‘zlari chanog‘idan chiqib keta bosh-ladi.
en: When the local investigator handed the military prosecutor’s official indictment with the examination record to the lawyer, our lawyer friend was already talking about another case with another person like himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: U endi ko‘ylaklarini yirtib, ko‘ksini, tomoqlarini tintalay boshladi...
en: Who was this “person like himself”?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bor kuchi bilan zo‘r berib nafas olishga tirishardi. So‘ngra buzuq ovoz bilan zo‘rg‘azo ‘rg‘a:
en: A local whom everyone, wherever he happened to be, knew and feared.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bo‘g‘ma, bo‘g‘ma meni!.. — deb qichqirdi.
en: The local Muslims called him “Obrezqora”—black washbasin.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bir-ikkita qadam bosib, devordagi jovonga suyandi, bir nafas tinch qolgach, yana bo‘g‘ziga qo‘l uzatib, etlarini cho‘zdi.
en: He was of average height, swarthy complexion, and rather thin. If our lawyer was a Russian lawyer, then Obrezqora was a Muslim lawyer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘ksiga mushtladi.
en: If some court needed
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Undan keyin bir qo‘lini yuqori ko‘tarib, boshiga qo‘ydi.
en: false testimony, then Obrezqora was ready. Everyone knew of his deception.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘zida ikki-uch tomchi yirik-yirik yosh ko‘ringan edi.
en: Judges, landowners, and other respected leaders all fought with him, and they always lost!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: G‘alati, yuvosh, muloyim, beozor va ayanch nazar bilan Zebiga qaradi va ikkala qo‘lini qo‘yib yuborib, boshini bir tomonga shilq etib tashladi-da, o‘zi ham devorga suykana-suykana sekingina yerga o‘tirdi, bir nafas o‘tirgandan keyin bir tarafga qiyshayib, ohistagina
en: “Obrezqora won’t stop with his banditry,” they would tell each other. With Obrezqora’s case in front of him, one from which he could work the client for no less than 5,, spending time on a military case defending a local seemed rather trivial to our lawyer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: yonginasiga yiqildi va shu bo‘yicha qimirlamay qoldi...
en: He quickly ran his eyes over the indictment and the investigation notes and tossed them aside.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nafas ichiga tushgani holda devorga orqasini berib butun bu fojiani kuzatayotgan Zebi bo‘lgan ishni angladimi, yo‘qmi — har holda, qish kunida, yugurganicha kuylakchan tashqariga chiqdi va ixtiyorsiz faryod soldi.
en: Like Sufis in a trance ignore the world around them, the lawyer put the case out of his mind until the very day of the trial. Why could the little Plevako of a little town not spare the time to look over two pages?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kundoshlari ham birin-birin uyg‘onib chiqdilar va mingboshining keng ichkarisida azonga yaqin to‘rt xotinning azani bildirgan yig‘i ovozi ko‘tarildi.
en: Across the street from the town’s train station, there was an opium den in which he and Obrezqora spent all day gambling. It wasn’t a matter of time, but interest.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ular orasida o‘q otib mo‘ljaliga tegizolmagan Poshshaxon ham boridi.
en: On the day of the trial, he found the two orphaned pages and read them cursorily over breakfast.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kim biladi, mingboshining o‘limiga yig‘laydimi u juvon, yo Miryoqubning bevafo-lig‘iga, yo bo‘lmasa hayf ketgan kuchalaga...
en: He read them so quickly and carelessly that his tea on the table didn’t have time to cool.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: XIX Kundoshlik orqasida yuz bergan bu jinoyat zamonning nozikligi orqasida olovga tashlangan jizzadek bo‘ldi.
en: The content of the two pages seemed to him like childish banter, and he smiled while reading them as a grandfather does at the mischief of his children.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Kichkinagina uezd shahrining kichkina va tor miyali amaldorlari — hammasi askardan yetishgan «azamatlar» — kelishmagan bir tasodifning to‘rt chaqaga arzimagan bu qurbonini zamonning zo‘r qahramoni da-rajasiga ko‘tarib yubordilar.
en: But we cannot fault the defender’s indifference as the only factor contributing to the travesty of our impending trial. The investigator’s secretary didn’t have a type writer, so he painstakingly wrote the record by hand.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shu bilan ular yangi fath etilgan o‘lkada va yangigina bo‘ysungan «vahshiy» xalq orasida juda yaxshi va ziyrak siyosat yurgizib, o‘sha xalq orasidan shunday eslik va tadbirlik, toju taxtga nisbatan shunday sodiq va astoydil ma’mur yetishtirganliklarini o‘zlaridan yuqori amaldorlarga qo‘rsatmoq istardilar.
en: The names of local Muslims he wrote like any barely literate child, in place of Akbarali sometimes recording Umarali, sometimes Amir o’g’li, and sometimes Qambar vali. And really what’s the difference?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bularning shuncha yillar zo‘r berib zo‘rg‘a-zo‘rg‘a yetishtirgan ziyrak davlat odamlarini munaqa osongina (kuchala bilan!) o‘ldirib keta bersalar, o‘lka-da tutilgan siyosatning va ham u siyosatni amalga oshiruvchilarning bir chaqalik obro‘si qoladimi?
en: How can you write what no one can pronounce? If it’s Akbar or Qambar, they’re both the same, right?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ayniqsa yerli xalq o‘rtasida?
en: They’re sart names! To be fair, in its final form the examination record was very neatly written.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Siyosatning obro‘sizligi nima de-mak?
en: The paper was flat like train tracks.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Idora usulining obro‘sizligi emasmi?
en: And just look at the d’s and b’s! You’ll be amazed!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hindistonga qo‘shni va darvoza bo‘lgan bir mustamlakadagi siyosatga to‘kis-tugal obro‘ ta’min etilgan bo‘lishi kerak.
en: The tails on the b’s curved up and to the left, and those on the d’s— down and to the right. Both their little tails, like coiled snakes, turned around and around!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Yo‘qsa natija yomon.
en: It wasn’t a record but a spectacle! And what a spectacle!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qo‘rqinch!!! Mana shu vahima va tashvishlar bilan liq to‘lib Toshkentga tomon qanot qoqqan depeshalar (rasmiy telegrammalar) voqeaning uchinchi kunida Toshkentdan O‘lka harbiy sudining sayyor hay’atini uchirib keldi.
en: The record described the crime, the victim, the victim’s many years of service to the Russian state, and the ingenuity and mastery he had demonstrated in state matters.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘roqning o‘zi esa sudning yetib kelishidan ham tez o‘tdi.
en: The murderer woman’s identity was passed over with a few words.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: «Munday shoshilinch sud urush maydonlarida bo‘lmasa, boshqa joyda bo‘lishiga aqlim yetmaydi!» deb piching qilib gapirdi tilmoch...
en: The witnesses (mingboshi’s other three wives) all unanimously confirmed that they hadn’t aided the crime: “No one other than Zebi participated,” they said.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu odam eskidan beri sudlarda ishlab, muttahamlikka guvohnoma olgan qadrdon tulkilardan emas, negadir chetdan, xolis kishilar orasidan chaqirilgan edi.
en: The neighbors, however, said: “Mingboshi’s other wives were accustomed to neglect and subservience.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Uni shahar odamlari, ayniqsa, yerli xalq kam taniydi.
en: Zebi, on the other hand, had long resisted her husband and faked illness.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Nihoyati, pochtada ishlovchi (o‘zi yerli xalkdan yetishib qolgan!) pastroq bir ma’mur...
en: Later, she seemed to have acquiesced to him, and they lived happily together a few days.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ammo zakunchi... Zakunchi — boshqa odam!
en: Her recent softness, we think, was a ploy to throw us off.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu odam, yo‘q, bu zot Turkiston o‘lkasining qaysi bir olis joyida (Zakaspiyda emasmikan?) davlat xazinasining ko‘pgina pulini yeb qo‘ygan askariy bir to‘ra.
en: She must have planned this all along.” Mingboshi’s second wife, Poshshaxon, a day before the murder, had fallen ill and was lying in convalescence.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Agar haqiqiy qonunlarga amal qilinganda, uni yo otish, yo umrlik surgun qilish shart edi.
en: She was questioned in that prone position. The questions to and answers of the accused were given the least space in this magnificent record.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Faqat u o‘zi juda issiq mamlakatda yashasa ham, boshida qalinqalin  soyabonlari bor ekan, ular o‘z kishilarini butunlay kuydirib tashlashga yo‘l qo‘ymaganlar.
en: So little, in fact, that the secretary didn’t even have to dip his pen in ink a second time. What a pity for all the poor investigator’s copious efforts with Zebi!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ularning soyalarida bu zot askariy rutbalaridangina ajrab, kissasi ko‘p ham qoqlanmasdan, o‘lkaning u chekkasidan bu chekkasiga «surgun» bo‘lib, o‘z istagi bilan «surgun» bo‘lib kelgan va munda... xususiy zakunchilik kasbiga kirishgan.
en: He asked her all of two questions to which Zebi gave all of two answers. The questions were short, and the answers shorter still: “Who gave mingboshi the water?” “I did.” “So you killed mingboshi?” “No.” The official indictment was pithier than the examination record!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Davlatni aldab o‘rinlatgan kishi boshqalarni aldab o‘rinlatolmaydimi? Tajriba — zo‘r, davlat — o‘zi!
en: It contained the conclusion of the record and a few words about mingboshi’s great service.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu odamning cho‘pqatlari juda ko‘p. O‘z-o‘zini hurmatlay bilgan hech bir zakunchi tomonidan olinmaydirgan hamma «gumonlik ishlar»ni shu kishi oladi va ko‘pincha yutib chiqadi.
en: A laconic demand followed: “Let such and such be punished by such and such according to such and such an article.” The lawyer arrived half an hour before the trial.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon

uz: Unda bu ishning asosan siyosiy bir rangdan xoli emasligi iqror qilinmoq bilan birga, bu so‘roqqa to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri aloqasi bo‘lmaganligi, ishning u jihatini alohida tekshirib, lozim ko‘rilgani taqdirda, qaytadan ish qo‘zg‘atmoq tegishli mahkamalarning vazifasi ekanligi; endi bu o‘ldirish hodisasi to‘g‘risiga kelganda, masalaning juda aniq anglashilganligi, aybdorning o‘zi tomonidan necha martalar iqror qilingani, shu uchun guvoh jalbiga va muzokaraga lozim ko‘rilmaganligi aytiladi. Undan keyin: «Aybdorning qilgan gunohi og‘ir bo‘lib, hozirgi urush vaqtida va nozik sharoitlar ichida davlat odamiga qasd qilgani uchun falon moddalar bo‘yicha oliy jazoga hukm qilish kerak bo‘lsada, bovujud O‘lka harbiy sudining sayyor hay’ati aybdorning madaniyatsiz yerli xalq ayoli ekanini, o‘zining yosh va turmushda tajribasizligini va ham hamma gunohlarini nomus bilan iqror qilib bo‘yniga olganini nazarda tutib, falon, falon moddalar bo‘yicha yetti yil surgunga hukm qildi.
en: “Our eshon won’t give a thing.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu hukm ustidan tegishli joylarga shikoyat qilish mumkin», deyiladi.
en: He’ll say he’ll give me whatever he has, but he’ll never part with a kopeck.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tilmoch hukmnomani to‘rt og‘izgina qilib eshittir-di:
en: He has enough to sate the appetite of any lawyer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Aybdor Zebinisa Razzoq so‘fi qizi Harbiy sudning hukmi bilan yetti yil Sibir qilindingiz.
en: But what can you do with a man who never learned to give, only to take?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Norozi bo‘lib ariza bersangiz mumkin.
en: The addicted always indulge, they say.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hukmnoma o‘qilib bitar-bitmas, zaldagilar chiqa boshlagan edilar.
en: Our eshon could never unlearn his greed.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: O‘qilib tamom bo‘lgach, sud raisining ishorati bilan, qilich yalang‘ochlagan konvoylar yana boyagi taxlitda Zebini olib chiqib ketishdi. Shundan key-in sud hay’ati ham chiqib ketdi.
en: If a beggar came to the lodge, the eshon would look at his empty hand and ask, ‘what happened to your offering?’ “I have to tell the girl’s poor mother what happened!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zalda faqat tilmoch, zakunchi; undan keyin nima uchun o‘zining bu yerga chaqirilganini bilmagan imom domla qolgan edi.
en: I am stone, I can take it, but her love for that girl is so strong that she can break stones!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tilmoch domla imomning yoniga keldi:
en: No, I can’t go home tonight.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Taqsir, siz jindak sabr qiling.
en: Tonight, I’ll stay here.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Men hozir kelaman, undan keyin gaplashamiz.
en: I’ll talk with the eshon, ask his advice.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domla yuragini qo‘liga olib, rangi o‘chgan, lablari bir oz qaltiragani holda... sud zalida qoldi.
en: He’ll know what to do. But I haven’t been home in two days.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zakunchi tilmochni olib tashqariga — Zebining yoniga chiqdi, Zebi chimmat ostida ho‘ngur-ho‘ngur yig‘lamoqda edi.
en: When I left, I said that I was only going to the Friday prayer.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zakunchi so‘radi: — Nima deysiz?
en: What will the old woman think?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ariza yozib beraymi? Zebi xo‘rsingan ovoz bilan yig‘lab turib, uzuq-uzuq javob qildi.
en: And if she hears this horrible piece of news from someone else, she might turn to stone herself!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Kimga? — Yuqoriga.
en: No, I should go and support her.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Unda... nima bo‘ladi?
en: … No! Whatever happens, wait for the eshon.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Nima bo‘laridi: ehtimol, yana so‘roq bo‘ladi; ishni qaytadan ko‘radilar. — Kim... ko‘radi?
en: But what will he say?” Finally, the eshon came.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shular... ko‘radimi? — Boshqa sud ko‘radi.
en: His spirits were high and there was a playfulness in his voice.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Baribir... op-ochiq turgan narsani... bular tushunmaydi-yu, ular tushunarmidi?
en: “He must have been drinking fermented horse milk at the wedding,” thought Razzoq-sufi. “They say if you drink a lot, it can ruin you.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ariza yozib beraymi? — Qo‘yaqol!..
en: Where did he get fermented horse milk in winter?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Men uchun... ovora bo‘lib o‘tirma... Zakunchi kulumsirab tilmochga qaradi, u yelkasini qoqdi.
en: Fine, he knows best.” The eshon had heard the news already but didn’t know that it concerned his murid Razzoq-sufi.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zakunchi boqcha darvozasidan chiqib ketmak uchun o‘sha tomonga qarab yurdi.
en: As Razzoq retold the events as he knew them, big pearls of tears appeared in his eyes. His master smiled as he listened (smiled!).
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Hay, shoshma, — dedi Zebi. — Shaharda...
en: That cheerful smile, along with his high spirits, did not recede.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shaharda... ota-onam... bor... ko‘rsatarmikin?
en: Even when Razzoq-sufi arrived at the most terrifying part, the eshon’s face didn’t change.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Avaxtaga olib borgandan keyin ko‘rsatadi.
en: “It’s like I’m talking to a stone,” thought Razzoq.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Zakunchi darvozaga qarab ketdi.
en: He immediately repented of his thought.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tilmoch u bilan xayrlashgach, yana domlaning yoniga kirdi.
en: When he finished, Razzoq stared at the eshon’s mouth, hoping for some words of wisdom.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Eshoni mirza, — dedi domla imom uni besaranjonlik bilan qarshi olib, — meni nimaga chaqirgan ekanlar?
en: But the eshon only became more elated. Humming a cheerful melody, the eshon began swaying his head to and fro.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tilmoch kuldi:
en: He opened his mouth to sing: This ephemeral world is ours for five days, only five days, ho-ov, Break your Sufi oath, break it quickly now, ho-ov! Let our crystal glasses overflow with wine, wine bearer hey, Otherwise, our lodge will be dark as night, as night, ho-ov.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Sizni, taqsir, sud sadri chaqirtirgan edi.
en: Razzoq-sufi’s eyes bulged in disbelief. This was the first time he had bulged his eyes at his master.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Basharti qasam berish lozim
en: “Sir, if you could just give … some advice. …”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: bo‘lib qolsa, musulmon shariatiga muvofiq qasam berish uchun.
en: “Advice?” asked the eshon, guffawing. “What advice can there be for the father of a murderer, Razzoq?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Qasam bermadilar-ku? — Lozim bo‘lmadi, taqsir.
en: Why didn’t they sentence the father along with the child, idiots!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ayol o‘zi iqror... Domla anglayolmadi, shekilli, mirzaning so‘ngi so‘zini savol shaklida qaytardi:
en: Do those infidels know what justice is?!” It was as if Razzoq-sufi’s body had suddenly caught fire.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘zi iqror?! Tilmoch yana kuldi:
en: He felt as if his whole being was burning.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, o‘zi iqror... Eshitmadingizmi?
en: His hands raised involuntarily over his head and balled into fists.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — O‘zi iqror emas, inkor qildi, shekilli-ku?
en: He wanted to bring his fist down on the eshon’s head.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Damingizni chiqarmang, taqsir.
en: But who was in front of him? His master!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Bu nozik masa-la...
en: His eshon! The great elder eshon!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ha, albatta, albatta...
en: No, he couldn’t raise his fist against him!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Endi, taqsir, sud raisining sizdan iltimosi bor: o‘zingiz eshitdingiz, bu ayol Razzoq so‘fi degan odamning qizi, o‘z eriga zahar bergan.
en: After a moment, Razzoq-sufi melted like snow and his shame drove him quietly out the door. He went home and lay down without uttering a word.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Eri xizmati singgan mingboshilardan ekan.
en: He didn’t answer his wife’s questions. “Again, his mood has soured!” she thought.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Prokuror otib o‘ldirilsin, degan edi, sud qabul qilmasdan, yetti yilga Sibirga kesdi.
en: The poor thing still hadn’t heard about Zebi. The next morning over breakfast, he carefully told her everything that had happened.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ertaga jumadan keyin machitda ikki og‘iz gapirib qo‘ysangiz, dedilar. — Nima to‘g‘rida, mirza?
en: The fist that he was about to bring down on the eshon’s head the previous night now came down on his own head.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Ya’ni oq podshoning sodiq odamlariga kim qo‘l ko‘tarsa, oqibati mana shunday bo‘ladi, degan mazmun-da... — Xo‘p, eshon mirza, xo‘p.
en: And that fist was so powerful that Razzoq-sufi only had time to think: “Oh, if only yesterday I had …” By the time he went out on the street, having left his tea untouched, Razzoq -sufi no longer recognized himself.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Albatta, aytaman, albatta. Endi menga ruxsatmikin?
en: He moved swiftly and unconsciously as if carried by the quick legs of Muslims in a funeral procession.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domlaning bu savolida xuddi gunoh qilgan odamning ochiq bezovtaligi sezilardi: «Meni qamamasmikin?» deganday...
en: He closed and opened his fists. In a powerful wave, a scream forced its way to his throat, but it got stuck there.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tilmoch muni payqadi, shekilli, quruq va sovuq javob berdi: — Bora bering.
en: Those who passed him on the street went without greetings, questions went without answers from him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Domla, maktabidan «ozod» bo‘lgan eski maktab bolalari singari, o‘zini eshikka urdi va o‘sha onda ko‘zdan yo‘qbo‘ldi.
en: Women cursed him as they passed. “Is he crazy?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tilmoch kuldi: «imon yo‘q taqsirimda», dedi o‘z-o‘ziga.
en: What’s wrong?” they said, but Razzoq-sufi only heard “who is crazy?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ngra bitta-bitta qadam bosib eshikka tomon borarkan, aylanib orqasiga qaradi; keng zal bo‘m-bo‘sh, xuddi yetimchadek ko‘rinadi. Suddan so‘ng u yoq-bu yokda tartibsiz qolib ketgan kursilar, bozorchilarning karvonsaroyda bog‘lagan otlari singari, birbirlariga  teskari evrilganlar...
en: The Russians or us?” The cart-drivers’ “Get, get!” sounded like “Die already!” He stared at the snout of a horse that stopped near his shoulder and said, as if to everyone and no one, “die yourselves, just die!” The cartdrivers then just went around him.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ko‘k yopiqli uzun stol ustida sud a’zolaridan birining ko‘zoynak qutichasi qolib ketgan; zal o‘rtasidagi og‘zi ochiq pechdan o‘tinning charsillab yongani eshitiladi.
en: At the bazaar, a baker offered him a basket of bread. Razzoq-sufi involuntary reached out and took two loaves, but quickly put them back and chuckled at the baker: “I take and I give,” he said, “but that man knows only how to take.” And he went on his way.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Tilmoch yana oldinga yurdi va boshini chayqay-chayqay.
en: He slowed his gait as he began to think.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Bezobrazie, bezobrazie!20 — deb so‘zlandi.
en: “God, even God, gives and takes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: XX Juma namozidan so‘ng tashqaridagi jamoat duv eta o‘rnidan turdi va fotihani kutmasdan, o‘z ishiga ketdi.
en: First, he gives life and then he takes it. Land too.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ayvondagilar ham ularga qo‘shildilar.
en: Land gives its fruits and accepts bodies.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Unda-munda yakka-yarim kishilarning bo‘ynilarini quyi egib-egib, fotihani kutganliklari ko‘rilardi.
en: It takes what it gives! What are you, master, you?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Namoz duosi, undan so‘ng «duoyi xolis» o‘tgach, ayvon bilan tashqari tomon bo‘shadi; xonaqo ichidan ham yo‘tala-yo‘tala bir necha kishi chiqib ketdi.
en: Are you better than God? Better than the land?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Ular ham chiqib bitgach, imom turib, so‘z boshladi.
en: You take, but you don’t give. You take, but you don’t give!”
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Umuman, jamoat oldida gapirishni sevmaydigan o‘zining imomlik vazifasiga ham juda rasmiy ravishda qaraydigan; uyidan jomega kelib, jomedan uyiga qaytguncha salom-alikdan boshqaga og‘iz ochmaydigan, onda-sonda yangi kelinchakday muloyim va yumshoq yo‘talib qo‘yadigan, ingichka ovozli domla imom bir necha og‘iz so‘z qilib, sud raisining iltimosini rasman o‘rniga qo‘ydi va qaytib joyiga o‘tirdi.
en: Razzoq-sufi’s mad screaming broke the “meditative silence,” that is, the sleep of the eshon. He was startled awake.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Shundan keyin xonaqodagilar asta-sekin chika boshladilar.
en: He opened his eyes, but before he could look around, Razzoq came running in shrieking.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Hamma chiqib bo‘lgandan so‘ng, bir-ikki marta ingichka yo‘talib domla ham o‘rnidan turdi va eshikka tomon yurdi.
en: Foaming at the mouth, he shook his head and yelled: “God! God gives life and only then does he take it away.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Xonaqo ichi yarim qorong‘i edi.
en: Who are you? Are you better than God?!” “My God!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Eshik oldida qorong‘ilikdan birdaniga bir ovoz keldi: — Taqsir, arzim bor edi...
en: May your tongue fall off, you wretched thing!
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: So‘ylovchisi qorong‘ida qolib ko‘zga ko‘rinmaganligi uchun domla bu kutilmagan sharpadan cho‘chib tushdi:
en: Infidel!” Razzoq-sufi continued to talk that way, bringing his face in to meet the eshon’s. “First the land gives and then it takes.
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: — Astag‘furullo! — dedi domla shoshilib va orqasiga tisarilib, qo‘lini ko‘ksiga olib bordi.
en: Are you better than the land?!” “What’s wrong with you, Razzoq?
author: Abdulhamid Cho‘lpon
license: Mualliflik huquqi egalariga tegishli. Faqat ilmiy tadqiqot uchun cheklangan parcha.

uz: Qorong‘idagi odam yoriqqa chiqib kelib, so‘zida davom qildi:
